intro: 拉紹德豐與勒洛克勒是兩座位於瑞士侏羅山區的城鎮，彼此相距不遠，所處土地不適合農耕，環境偏遠。它們的城市規劃與建築反映了鐘錶製造業對合理化組織的需求。兩座城鎮在十九世紀初大火之後重新規劃，其存在完全仰賴單一產業。街區以開放式的平行帶狀布局，住宅與工坊交錯其間，符合當地可追溯到十七世紀、至今仍存在的鐘錶文化需求。這處遺產依據標準（iv）登錄，因為它是單一產業製造城市規劃的傑出範例，並顯示城市布局如何配合生產方式而演變。工匠常在住家頂樓設置採光良好的工作室，生產與生活空間緊密結合，成為城市形態的特色。這種生產與居住結合的模式，成為後世研究工業城鎮規劃的重要案例。如今鐘錶業仍是當地重要產業，城鎮同時設有鐘錶博物館等文化設施，延續並詮釋這項傳統。
highlights: 兩座城鎮在十九世紀初大火後依鐘錶業需求重新規劃
開放式平行帶狀街區，住宅與工坊交錯
單一產業塑造整個城市的形態
鐘錶製造文化可追溯到十七世紀，至今延續
地處侏羅山區，環境不利農耕

zh: 龐特卡薩魯岧水道橋與運河
en_desc: Situated in north-eastern Wales, the 18 kilometre long Pontcysyllte Aqueduct and Canal is a feat of civil engineering of the Industrial Revolution, completed in the early years of the 19th century. Covering a difficult geographical setting, the building of the canal required substantial, bold civil engineering solutions, especially as it was built without using locks. The aqueduct is a pioneering masterpiece of engineering and monumental metal architecture, conceived by the celebrated civil engineer Thomas Telford. The use of both cast and wrought iron in the aqueduct enabled the construction of arches that were light and d strong, producing an overall effect that is both monumental and elegant. The property is inscribed as a masterpiece of creative genius, and as a remarkable synthesis of expertise already acquired in Europe. It is also recognized as an innovative ensemble that inspired many projects all over the world.
intro: 龐特卡薩魯岧水道與運河位於威爾斯東北部，全長18公里，是工業革命時期土木工程的傑出成就，於十九世紀初完成。運河穿過地形複雜的地帶，需要大膽的工程解決方案，尤其是它在建造時並未使用船閘。其中的水道橋是由著名土木工程師托馬斯·特爾福德構思的開創性傑作，也是金屬建築的紀念碑式範例。這處遺產依據標準（i）、（ii）與（iv）登錄。水道橋同時使用鑄鐵與熟鐵，使拱圈既輕巧又堅固，整體效果既雄偉又優雅。橋梁橫越迪河谷，船隻在高處的水槽中行駛，景象十分獨特。這項設計影響了後來的運河與橋梁工程，並促進了運輸與工業的發展。如今運河主要作為休閒用途，船隻與步行者均可通行，管理單位持續維護鑄鐵結構與運河水道，使這處工業時代的工程遺產得以保存並繼續使用。
highlights: 運河全長18公里，建造時未使用船閘
水道橋由托馬斯·特爾福德構思
同時運用鑄鐵與熟鐵，造就輕巧而堅固的拱圈
船隻在高於河谷的水槽中航行
如今主要供休閒船隻與步行者使用

en: Historic Monuments of Dengfeng in “The Centre of Heaven and Earth”
zh: 登封「天地之中」歷史建築群
en_desc: Mount Songshang is considered to be the central sacred mountain of China. At the foot of this 1500 metre high mountain, close to the city of Dengfeng in Henan province and spread over a 40 square-kilometre circle, stand eight clusters of buildings and sites, including three Han Que gates - remains of the oldest religious edifices in China -, temples, the Zhougong Sundial Platform and the Dengfeng Observatory. Constructed over the course of nine dynasties, these buildings are reflections of different ways of perceiving the centre of heaven and earth and the power of the mountain as a centre for religious devotion. The historical monuments of Dengfeng include some of the best examples of ancient Chinese buildings devoted to ritual, science, technology and education.
intro: 登封「天地之中」歷史建築群位於中國河南省登封市附近，嵩山被視為中國的中嶽，海拔約一千五百公尺。在山腳下方圓約四十平方公里的範圍內，分布著八組建築與遺址，包括三座漢代闕門，是中國現存最古老的宗教建築遺存之一，還有寺院、周公測景臺與登封觀星臺。這些建築歷經九個朝代陸續建成，反映了人們對「天地之中」的不同認識，以及山岳作為宗教崇拜中心的力量。這處遺產依據標準（iii）與（vi）登錄，其中包含中國古代天文與禮制建築的傑出範例。周公測景臺相傳與古人測量日影、確定地中有關；觀星臺則是元代天文學家郭守敬主持建造的天文設施。嵩山一帶同時匯集了儒、釋、道三教的建築，少林寺的塔林與嵩陽書院亦在其中，展現了不同信仰與學術傳統在同一山麓的共存。這處遺產目前受到國家級保護，並開放參觀。
highlights: 嵩山被視為中國的中嶽，是登錄的核心
八組建築與遺址歷經九個朝代建成
三座漢代闕門屬於中國現存最古老的宗教建築遺存
周公測景臺與登封觀星臺展現古代天文成就
儒、釋、道三教建築同處一個山麓

en_desc: The property includes a selection of eleven penal sites, among the thousands established by the British Empire on Australian soil in the 18 th and 19 th centuries. The sites are spread across Australia, from Fremantle in Western Australia to Kingston and Arthur's Vale on Norfolk Island in the east; and from areas around Sydney in New South Wales in the north, to sites located in Tasmania in the south. Around 166,000 men, women and children were sent to Australia over 80 years between 1787 and 1868, condemned by British justice to transportation to the convict colonies. Each of the sites had a specific purpose, in terms both of punitive imprisonment and of rehabilitation through forced labour to help build the colony. The Australian Convict Sites presents the best surviving examples of large-scale convict transportation and the colonial expansion of European powers through the presence and labour of convicts.
intro: 澳大利亞監獄遺址由十一處流刑地遺址組成，是英帝國在十八至十九世紀於澳洲土地上設立的數千處刑罰場所中的精選代表。遺址分布全澳，西起西澳洲的弗里曼特爾，東至諾福克島的京斯頓與亞瑟谷，北至雪梨周邊的新南威爾斯，南至塔斯馬尼亞。1787至1868年間，約有十六萬六千名男女與兒童被英國司法判處流放至澳洲殖民地。各處遺址有各自的功能，涵蓋懲罰性監禁，以及透過強制勞動達成的矯正與勞務。這處遺產依據標準（iv）與（vi）登錄，因為它是大規模流放囚犯並將其作為殖民勞動力的傑出例證，也與這段全球性的歷史事件有直接關聯。囚犯建造了道路、建築與港口，對澳洲殖民地的形成貢獻良多。這些遺址包含監獄、工廠、農場與官署建築，現今多半作為博物館或歷史遺跡開放，讓人理解這段歷史的複雜面向，包括刑罰制度、殖民統治與原住民的處境。
highlights: 由分布全澳與諾福克島的十一處遺址組成
1787至1868年間約有十六萬六千人被流放
各遺址分別承擔不同的監禁與勞動功能
囚犯勞動為殖民地的基礎建設作出貢獻
多數遺址已轉為博物館或歷史遺跡

en: Paraty and Ilha Grande – Culture and Biodiversity
zh: 帕拉蒂與格蘭德島：文化與生物多樣性
en_desc: This natural-cultural landscape encompasses the historic centre of Paraty, one of Brazil's best-preserved coastal towns, four Brazilian Atlantic Forest protected natural areas, one of the world’s five key biodiversity hotspots, as well as part of the Serra da Bocaina mountain range and the Atlantic coastal region. Serra do Mar and Ilha Grande Bay is home to an impressive diversity of animal species, some of which are threatened, such as the jaguar ( Panthera onca ), the white-lipped peccary ( Tayassu pecari ) and several primate species, including the Southern Muriqui ( Brachyteles arachnoides ), which are emblematic of the property. In the late 17th century, Paraty was the end-point of the Caminho do Ouro (Gold Route), along which gold was shipped to Europe. Its port also served as an entry point for tools and African slaves, sent to work in the mines. A defence system was built to protect the wealth of the port and the town. The historic centre of Paraty has retained its 18th century plan and much of its colonial architecture dating from the 18th and early 19th centuries.
intro: 帕拉蒂與大伊莉亞位於巴西東南沿海，是一處自然與文化兼具的複合遺產。它涵蓋帕拉蒂歷史中心，是巴西保存最完好的沿海城鎮之一，以及四處大西洋森林保護區，這是世界五大生物多樣性熱點之一，另包括博卡伊納山脈的一部分與大西洋沿岸地帶。這處遺產依據標準（v）與（x）登錄。海岸山脈與大伊莉亞灣擁有豐富的動物物種，其中不少屬瀕危，如美洲豹、白唇西貒，以及包括南方絨毛蛛猴在內的多種靈長類動物，南方絨毛蛛猴是此地的代表物種。十七世紀晚期，帕拉蒂是將內陸米納斯吉拉斯所產黃金運往海岸的終點，歷史中心的街道與建築保留了殖民時期的格局。城鎮與周邊森林、海灣之間的長期互動，形成了傳統社群與自然環境共存的景觀，其中包括原住民與傳統社群的生活方式。保護工作需要兼顧生物多樣性、歷史城鎮與沿岸發展的壓力。
highlights: 歷史中心是巴西保存最完好的沿海城鎮之一
涵蓋大西洋森林，屬世界生物多樣性熱點
美洲豹與南方絨毛蛛猴是代表性物種
十七世紀晚期是黃金運往海岸的終點
文化與自然兼具的複合遺產
zh_prev: 帕拉蒂與大伊莉亞——文化與生物多樣性

en: Cidade Velha, Historic Centre of Ribeira Grande
zh: 里貝拉格蘭德歷史中心（西達迪韋利亞）
en_desc: The town of Ribeira Grande, renamed Cidade Velha in the late 18th century, was the first European colonial outpost in the tropics. Located in the south of the island of Santiago, the town features some of the original street layout impressive remains including two churches, a royal fortress and Pillory Square with its ornate 16th century marble pillar.
intro: 韋利亞城原名大里貝拉，十八世紀晚期改稱韋利亞城，位於維德角聖地亞哥島南部，是歐洲人在熱帶地區建立的第一個殖民據點。遺址保存了部分原有的街道格局，以及令人印象深刻的遺跡，包括兩座教堂、一座皇家要塞，還有廣場上一根十六世紀的精美大理石刑柱。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（vi）登錄，因為它在十五、十六世紀的大西洋歷史中扮演關鍵角色：這裡是歐洲、非洲與美洲之間商業與文化交流的重要中繼站，也與奴隸貿易的歷史密切相關。在這裡，歐洲與非洲的影響相互交融，產生了新的社會與文化形態，包括克里奧爾語和獨特的音樂與生活習慣。刑柱曾用於公開懲處，也象徵當時的殖民統治。隨著港口因海盜襲擊與政治經濟變化而衰落，首都功能逐漸遷往他處，使舊城保留了較為完整的早期面貌。今日遺址仍有居民生活，保護工作與社區發展需要並行。
highlights: 歐洲人在熱帶地區建立的第一個殖民據點
保留兩座教堂、皇家要塞與十六世紀大理石刑柱
與大西洋奴隸貿易的歷史密切相關
歐洲與非洲文化在此交融，孕育克里奧爾文化
舊城因首都功能遷移而保留早期面貌

en_desc: The Tower of Hercules has served as a lighthouse and landmark at the entrance of La Coruña harbour in north-western Spain since the late 1st century A.D. when the Romans built the Farum Brigantium. The Tower, built on a 57 metre high rock, rises a further 55 metres, of which 34 metres correspond to the Roman masonry and 21 meters to the restoration directed by architect Eustaquio Giannini in the 18 th century, who augmented the Roman core with two octagonal forms. Immediately adjacent to the base of the Tower, is a small rectangular Roman building. The site also features a sculpture park, the Monte dos Bicos rock carvings from the Iron Age and a Muslim cemetery. The Roman foundations of the building were revealed in excavations conducted in the 1990s. Many legends from the Middle Ages to the 19th century surround the Tower of Hercules, which is unique as it is the only lighthouse of Greco-Roman antiquity to have retained a measure of structural integrity and functional continuity.
intro: 埃庫萊斯塔位於西班牙西北部拉科魯尼亞港口的入口處，自公元一世紀晚期羅馬人建造「布里甘提姆燈塔」以來，一直作為燈塔與地標使用。塔建在一塊高57公尺的岩石上，再向上升高55公尺，其中34公尺為羅馬時期砌體，21公尺屬於十八世紀由建築師歐斯塔基奧·吉安尼尼主持的修復，他在羅馬核心之外增加了兩層八角形結構。塔底旁有一座小型長方形羅馬建築。遺產範圍也包括雕塑公園、鐵器時代的比科斯山岩刻以及一處穆斯林墓地。這處遺產依據標準（iii）登錄，因為它是現存最古老的羅馬燈塔，且至今仍在使用，見證了古代航海與信號傳遞的技術與傳統。塔的羅馬地基至今仍保存在後世增建的結構之下，歷史上這座燈塔也與大西洋沿岸航運、貿易路線密切相關。當地關於它的傳說與歷史敘事豐富，使這處古蹟兼具工程、航運與地方文化的意義。
highlights: 現存最古老的羅馬燈塔，至今仍在使用
塔高55公尺，建於57公尺高的岩石上
十八世紀修復時增添了兩層八角形結構
遺產範圍包含鐵器時代岩刻與穆斯林墓地
位於大西洋沿岸的拉科魯尼亞港入口

en: Heritage of Mercury. Almadén and Idrija
zh: 水銀的遺產：阿爾馬登和伊德里亞
en_desc: The property includes the mining sites of Almadén (Spain), where mercury (quicksilver) has been extracted since antiquity, and Idrija (Slovenia), where mercury was first found in AD1490. The Spanish property includes buildings relating to its mining history, including Retamar Castle, religious buildings and traditional dwellings. The site in Idrija notably features mercury stores and infrastructure, as well as miners’ living quarters, and a miners’ theatre. The sites bear testimony to the intercontinental trade in mercury which generated important exchanges between Europe and America over the centuries. Together they represent the two largest mercury mines in the world, operational until recent times.
intro: 水銀的遺產包含西班牙的阿爾馬登與斯洛維尼亞的伊德里亞兩處礦業遺址，兩者是世界上最大的兩座水銀礦。阿爾馬登自古代就開採水銀，伊德里亞則在公元1490年首次發現水銀。西班牙一側的遺產包括與礦業歷史相關的建築，如雷塔馬爾城堡、宗教建築與傳統住宅；伊德里亞則有水銀倉庫與設施、礦工居住區以及礦工劇院。這處遺產依據標準（ii）與（iv）登錄，因為它們見證了歐洲與美洲之間水銀的洲際貿易，數百年來促成了重要的交流。水銀在白銀提煉中扮演關鍵角色，因此與美洲殖民地的採礦業密不可分，這些礦場所生產的水銀被運往新大陸，影響了當時的經濟與社會。兩處礦區直到近年才停止運作，礦區與周邊聚落共同構成完整的礦業景觀，也記錄了採礦技術與礦工社群的生活。如今這些遺址轉為博物館與參觀場所，同時也面臨處理歷史汙染的課題。
highlights: 阿爾馬登與伊德里亞是世界最大的兩座水銀礦
阿爾馬登自古代開採，伊德里亞於1490年發現水銀
水銀是美洲白銀提煉的關鍵材料，促成洲際貿易
伊德里亞設有礦工劇院與水銀倉庫
遺產橫跨西班牙與斯洛維尼亞兩國

en_desc: The Wadden Sea is the largest unbroken system of intertidal sand and mud flats in the world. The site covers the Dutch Wadden Sea Conservation Area, the German Wadden Sea National Parks of Lower Saxony and Schleswig-Holstein, and most of the Danish Wadden Sea maritime conservation area. It is a large, temperate, relatively flat coastal wetland environment, formed by the intricate interactions between physical and biological factors that have given rise to a multitude of transitional habitats with tidal channels, sandy shoals, sea-grass meadows, mussel beds, sandbars, mudflats, salt marshes, estuaries, beaches and dunes. The area is home to numerous plant and animal species, including marine mammals such as the harbour seal, grey seal and harbour porpoise. Wadden Sea is one of the last remaining large-scale, intertidal ecosystems where natural processes continue to function largely undisturbed.
intro: 瓦登海是世界上最大的連續潮間帶沙灘與泥灘系統，涵蓋荷蘭瓦登海保護區、德國下薩克森邦與石勒蘇益格－荷爾斯泰因邦的瓦登海國家公園，以及丹麥大部分的瓦登海海洋保護區，後來又有擴充。這是一片溫帶、相對平坦的沿海濕地環境，由物理與生物因素之間複雜的交互作用形成，孕育出潮溝、沙洲、海草床、貽貝床、泥灘、鹽沼、河口、海灘與沙丘等多樣的過渡性棲地。這處遺產依據標準（viii）、（ix）與（x）登錄，涵蓋地質、生態演化過程與生物多樣性。這裡是無數動植物的家園，包括海洋哺乳動物與鳥類。作為候鳥遷徙路線上的重要中繼站，每年有數量龐大的鳥類在此覓食與休息，使其成為東大西洋遷飛路線上不可或缺的區域。潮汐每日漲退，不斷重塑地形，形成動態的自然系統。三國長期合作管理，應對航運、漁業、能源開發與海平面上升等壓力。
highlights: 全球最大的連續潮間帶沙灘與泥灘系統
由荷蘭、德國與丹麥三國共同保護
包含潮溝、鹽沼、海草床、貽貝床與沙丘等多樣棲地
是候鳥遷徙路線上重要的覓食與休息站
潮汐每日漲退，不斷塑造並更新地形

zh: 舒什塔爾歷史水力系統
en_desc: Shushtar, Historical Hydraulic System, inscribed as a masterpiece of creative genius, can be traced back to Darius the Great in the 5th century B.C. It involved the creation of two main diversion canals on the river Kârun one of which, Gargar canal, is still in use providing water to the city of Shushtar via a series of tunnels that supply water to mills. It forms a spectacular cliff from which water cascades into a downstream basin. It then enters the plain situated south of the city where it has enabled the planting of orchards and farming over an area of 40,000 ha. known as Mianâb (Paradise). The property has an ensemble of remarkable sites including the Salâsel Castel, the operation centre of the entire hydraulic system, the tower where the water level is measured, dams, bridges, basins and mills. It bears witness to the know-how of the Elamites and Mesopotamians as well as more recent Nabatean expertise and Roman building influence.
intro: 舒什塔爾歷史水力系統位於伊朗西南部，可追溯至公元前五世紀的大流士大帝時期。其工程在卡倫河上開鑿了兩條主要的分水渠，其中加爾加爾渠至今仍在使用，透過一系列隧道為舒什塔爾城供水，並驅動水磨。水流在懸崖處形成壯觀的瀑布，注入下游水潭，再流入城南的平原，使約四萬公頃的土地得以栽種果園與農作物，這片區域稱為米阿納布，意為「天堂」。遺產包括薩拉瑟爾城堡、運作中心、水壩橋、水磨與隧道等一系列引人注目的設施。這處遺產依據標準（i）、（ii）與（v）登錄，被視為創造性天才的傑作，因為它體現了古代工程師在水資源管理上的卓越才能，並見證了不同文化對水利技術的影響。它同時是人類與環境長期互動的範例，至今仍影響當地的農業與聚落型態。維護舊有設施並因應現代水資源利用，是目前的主要挑戰。
highlights: 可追溯至公元前五世紀大流士大帝時期
加爾加爾渠至今仍供水給舒什塔爾城
水流經隧道驅動水磨，並在懸崖形成瀑布
灌溉約四萬公頃土地，稱為「米阿納布」
是古代水資源管理與工程技術的傑出範例

en: Pitons, cirques and remparts of Reunion Island
zh: 留尼汪的皮通斯、環谷和環壁
en_desc: The Pitons, cirques and remparts of Reunion Island site coincides with the core zone of La Réunion National Park. The property covers more than 100,000 ha or 40 % of La Réunion, an island comprising two adjoining volcanic massifs located in the south-west of the Indian Ocean. Dominated by two towering volcanic peaks, massive walls and three cliff-rimmed cirques, the property includes a great variety of rugged terrain and impressive escarpments, forested gorges and basins creating a visually striking landscape. It is the natural habitat for a wide diversity of plants, presenting a high level of endemism. There are subtropical rainforests, cloud forests and heaths creating a remarkable and visually appealing mosaic of ecosystems and landscape features.
intro: 留尼汪的皮通斯、環谷和環壁位於印度洋西南部的留尼汪島，範圍與留尼汪國家公園的核心區重疊，面積超過十萬公頃，約占全島的百分之四十。島上由兩座相鄰的火山山體組成，景觀以兩座聳立的火山峰、巨大的陡壁及三個被懸崖環繞的環谷為主，崎嶇的地形、陡峭的斷崖、森林覆蓋的峽谷與盆地，形成視覺上極為震撼的風景。這處遺產依據標準（vii）與（x）登錄，其美學價值與生物多樣性都十分突出。這裡是多種植物的天然棲地，特有種比例很高，有亞熱帶雨林、雲霧林與灌叢荒地，形成罕見而美麗的植被組合。環谷與火山地貌展現了火山島嶼的演化過程，也提供了島嶼生態系的重要案例。這處遺產是該島保護自然環境與特有生物的核心區域，面臨的威脅包括外來入侵物種對原生植被的影響，管理單位也必須在保護與遊憩使用之間取得平衡。
highlights: 範圍涵蓋留尼汪島約百分之四十的面積
由兩座火山山體、巨大陡壁與三個環谷組成
擁有亞熱帶雨林、雲霧林與灌叢荒地等多樣植被
植物特有種比例高，具重要生物多樣性價值
外來入侵物種是主要的保護挑戰

en: Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power (568-774 A.D.)
zh: 義大利的倫巴底人遺址：權力之地（公元568至774年）
en_desc: The Longobards in Italy, Places of Power, 568 - 774 A.D. comprises seven groups of important buildings (including fortresses, churches, and monasteries) throughout the Italian Peninsula. They testify to the high achievement of the Lombards, who migrated from northern Europe and developed their own specific culture in Italy where they ruled over vast territories in the 6th to 8th centuries. The Lombards synthesis of architectural styles marked the transition from Antiquity to the European Middle Ages, drawing on the heritage of Ancient Rome, Christian spirituality, Byzantine influence and Germanic northern Europe. The serial property testifies to the Lombards' major role in the spiritual and cultural development of Medieval European Christianity, notably by bolstering the monastic movement.
intro: 倫巴底人在義大利：權力之地（公元568至774年）由七組重要建築群組成，包括堡壘、教堂與修道院，分布於義大利半島各地。它們見證了倫巴底人的卓越成就，這個民族從北歐遷入，在義大利發展出自己獨特的文化，並於六至八世紀統治廣大領土。倫巴底人綜合了多種建築風格，標誌著從古代過渡到歐洲中世紀，融合了古羅馬遺產、基督教靈性、拜占庭影響以及日耳曼北歐傳統。這處串聯式遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（vi）登錄，證明了倫巴底人在歐洲中世紀初期的精神與文化發展中扮演的重要角色。遺產地點包括奇維達萊的倫巴底小禮拜堂、卡斯泰爾塞普里奧的堡壘與教堂、斯波萊托的聖薩爾瓦托雷聖殿、布雷西亞的修道院群、貝內文托的聖索菲亞教堂等。這些建築展現了倫巴底王國的政治與宗教權力中心，以及教會與世俗統治者之間的關係，也反映了該時期藝術與信仰的融合。
highlights: 七組建築群分布於義大利半島各地
融合古羅馬、基督教、拜占庭與日耳曼傳統
見證從古代過渡到歐洲中世紀的轉折
包含堡壘、教堂與修道院等不同類型
反映倫巴底王國的政治與宗教權力中心
zh_prev: 義大利倫巴底：權力之地（公元568至774年）

en: Royal Tombs of the Joseon Dynasty
en_desc: The Royal Tombs of the Joseon Dynasty form a collection of 40 tombs scattered over 18 locations. Built over five centuries, from 1408 to 1966, the tombs honoured the memory of ancestors, showed respect for their achievements, asserted royal authority, protected ancestral spirits from evil and provided protection from vandalism. Spots of outstanding natural beauty were chosen for the tombs which typically have their back protected by a hill as they face south toward water and, ideally, layers of mountain ridges in the distance. Alongside the burial area, the royal tombs feature a ceremonial area and an entrance. In addition to the burial mounds, associated buildings that are an integral part of the tombs include a T-shaped wooden shrine, a shed for stele, a royal kitchen and a guards’ house, a red-spiked gate and the tomb keeper’s house. The grounds are adorned on the outside with a range of stone objects including figures of people and animals. The Joseon Tombs completes the 5,000 year history of royal tombs architecture in the Korean peninsula.
intro: 朝鮮王陵共有四十座陵墓，分散在十八個地點，興建時間橫跨1408年到1966年的五個世紀。這些陵墓用以紀念祖先、表達對其功績的敬意、彰顯王權，並保護祖先靈魂不受邪惡侵擾，同時防止破壞。陵址大多選在風景優美之處，背靠山丘，面朝南方的水域，理想情況下遠處還有層層山脊。陵墓除墳丘之外，還設有祭祀區與入口，並有作為整體一部分的附屬建築。這處遺產依據標準（iii）、（iv）與（vi）登錄，因為它延續了朝鮮王朝的喪葬與祭祀傳統，並體現儒家禮制與風水觀念。祭祀儀式至今仍在定期舉行，是活態的文化傳統。王陵的設計講求與自然環境的和諧，墳丘周圍的石像、碑石與樹林，構成莊嚴而靜謐的景觀。許多王陵位於首爾近郊，保存狀況良好，並開放給大眾參觀，也成為了解朝鮮王朝歷史與禮俗的重要場所。
highlights: 四十座陵墓分布於十八處，橫跨1408年至1966年
選址講究背山面水，反映風水觀念
陵區含墳丘、祭祀區與入口等部分
祭祀儀式至今仍定期舉行，延續傳統
陵區石像與碑石與自然景觀相互融合

en: The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier, an Outstanding Contribution to the Modern Movement
zh: 勒·柯比意的建築作品——對現代建築運動的卓越貢獻
en_desc: Chosen from the work of Le Corbusier, the 17 sites comprising this transnational serial property are spread over seven countries and are a testimonial to the invention of a new architectural language that made a break with the past. They were built over a period of a half-century, in the course of what Le Corbusier described as “patient research”. The Complexe du Capitole in Chandigarh (India), the National Museum of Western Art, Tokyo (Japan), the House of Dr Curutchet in La Plata (Argentina) and the Unité d’habitation in Marseille (France) reflect the solutions that the Modern Movement sought to apply during the 20th century to the challenges of inventing new architectural techniques to respond to the needs of society. These masterpieces of creative genius also attest to the internationalization of architectural practice across the planet.
intro: 勒·柯比意的建築作品由十七處場所組成，分布在阿根廷、比利時、瑞士、德國、法國、印度與日本七個國家，是一處跨國串聯式遺產。這些作品興建於約半個世紀間，是勒·柯比意所說的「耐心探索」的成果，見證了一種與過去決裂的新建築語言的發明。其中包括印度昌迪加爾的行政中心群、日本東京的國立西洋美術館、阿根廷拉普拉塔的庫魯切特醫師住宅，以及法國馬賽的馬賽公寓，它們反映了現代主義運動在二十世紀為因應新建築技術與社會需求所提出的解決方案。這處遺產依據標準（i）、（ii）與（vi）登錄，因為它展現了現代建築運動的創造力，並將建築與人類社會的需求相連，影響遍及全球。這些作品也顯示了勒·柯比意在住宅、公共建築與城市規劃上的多方面嘗試，並將現代建築的理念傳播到不同大陸。各處遺址的所有者與管理方式不一，需要跨國協調以維護其真實性。
highlights: 十七處場所分布於七個國家，橫跨三大洲
作品跨越約半個世紀，是「耐心探索」的成果
包含昌迪加爾行政中心群與馬賽公寓
東京國立西洋美術館是遺產中的亞洲作品之一
將現代建築理念傳播到不同大陸

en_desc: The first capital of Côte d’Ivoire, the Historic Town of Grand-Bassam, is an example of a late 19 th - and early 20 th -century colonial town planned with quarters specializing in commerce, administration, housing for Europeans and for Africans. The site includes the N’zima African fishing village alongside colonial architecture marked by functional houses with galleries, verandas and gardens. Grand-Bassam was the most important port, economic and judicial centre of Côte d’Ivoire. It bears witness to the complex social relations between Europeans and Africans, and to the subsequent independence movement. As a vibrant centre of the territory of French trading posts in the Gulf of Guinea, which preceded modern Côte d’Ivoire, it attracted populations from all parts of Africa, Europe and the Mediterranean Levant.
intro: 大巴桑歷史城鎮是象牙海岸的第一個首都，位於該國南部沿海，是十九世紀晚期至二十世紀初期殖民城鎮規劃的範例，市區劃分為商業、行政、歐洲人住宅及非洲人住宅等不同街區。遺產範圍內有恩濟馬非洲漁村，以及殖民時期的建築，這些建築以附有迴廊、陽臺與庭園的實用型住宅為特色。大巴桑曾是象牙海岸最重要的港口，也是經濟與司法中心。這處遺產依據標準（iii）與（iv）登錄，因為它見證了歐洲人與非洲人之間複雜的社會關係，以及其後的獨立運動，同時是幾內亞灣法國貿易據點中一個活躍的中心。城鎮規劃反映當時殖民行政的分區概念，不同族群居住在不同區域，同時也留下了多元文化接觸的痕跡。二十世紀初首都遷往他處之後，大巴桑逐漸失去政治地位，不少建築閒置老化。目前保護工作的重點，在於修復殖民建築並維持社區的生活與文化傳承。
highlights: 象牙海岸第一個首都，也是重要港口
街區分為商業、行政與歐洲人、非洲人住宅區
殖民建築以迴廊、陽臺與庭園為特色
遺產範圍內包含恩濟馬非洲漁村
見證殖民社會關係與獨立運動歷史

en: Historic Villages of Korea: Hahoe and Yangdong
zh: 韓國歷史村落：河回村和良洞村
en_desc: Founded in the 14th-15th centuries, Hahoe and Yangdong are seen as the two most representative historic clan villages in the Republic of Korea. Their layout and location - sheltered by forested mountains and facing out onto a river and open agricultural fields – reflect the distinctive aristocratic Confucian culture of the early part of the Joseon Dynasty (1392-1910). The villages were located to provide both physical and spiritual nourishment from their surrounding landscapes. They include residences of the head families, together with substantial timber framed houses of other clan members, also pavilions, study halls, Confucian academies for learning, and clusters of one story mud-walled, thatched-roofed houses, formerly for commoners. The landscapes of mountains, trees and water around the village, framed in views from pavilions and retreats, were celebrated for their beauty by 17th and 18th century poets.
intro: 河回村與良洞村位於韓國慶尚北道，創建於十四至十五世紀，被視為韓國最具代表性的兩座歷史氏族村落。村落的布局與位置，背倚森林覆蓋的山脈，面向河流與開闊的農田，反映了朝鮮王朝（1392至1910年）初期獨特的貴族儒家文化。村落的選址既能提供實質的生活資源，也兼顧精神層面的滋養。村內有宗家住宅、其他氏族成員的大型木構房屋，以及亭閣、書堂、供學習的儒家書院，並有成群的單層泥牆草屋。這處遺產依據標準（iii）與（iv）登錄，因為它們是朝鮮王朝時期氏族村落生活方式的傑出見證，並完整保存了這種聚落形態與儒家社會秩序。兩處村落的氏族後裔至今仍居住於此，傳統節慶、祭祀與生活方式得以延續，使村落不僅是歷史遺跡，也是活態的文化空間。河回村因河流環繞村子而得名，村落文化還包括傳統的假面舞劇。保護工作須兼顧居民的生活需求與觀光壓力。
highlights: 河回村與良洞村是韓國最具代表性的歷史氏族村落
選址背山面水，兼顧生活資源與精神寄託
保存宗家住宅、亭閣、書堂與儒家書院
氏族後裔至今仍居住於村中
反映朝鮮王朝初期的貴族儒家文化

zh: 菲尼克斯群島保護區域
en_desc: The Phoenix Island Protected Area (PIPA) is a 408,250 sq.km expanse of marine and terrestrial habitats in the Southern Pacific Ocean. The property encompasses the Phoenix Island Group, one of three island groups in Kiribati, and is the largest designated Marine Protected Area in the world. PIPA conserves one of the world's largest intact oceanic coral archipelago ecosystems, together with 14 known underwater sea mounts (presumed to be extinct volcanoes) and other deep-sea habitats. The area contains approximately 800 known species of fauna, including about 200 coral species, 500 fish species, 18 marine mammals and 44 bird species. The structure and functioning of PIPA's ecosystems illustrates its pristine nature and importance as a migration route and reservoir. This is the first site in Kiribati to be inscribed on the World Heritage List.
intro: 菲尼克斯群島保護區域位於南太平洋，面積408,250平方公里，涵蓋海洋與陸地棲地，範圍包括吉里巴斯三個島群之一的菲尼克斯群島，是世界上最大的指定海洋保護區之一。這處遺產保護了全球最大且完整的海洋珊瑚群島生態系之一，以及十四座已知的海底山，推測為已熄滅的火山，還有其他深海棲地。保護區內已知有約八百種動物，包括約兩百種珊瑚、五百種魚類、十八種海洋哺乳動物與四十四種鳥類。這處遺產依據標準（vii）與（ix）登錄，因為它展現了大洋珊瑚群島生態系的結構與運作，並具有出色的自然美景。由於遠離人口與開發，這些珊瑚礁相對少受干擾，是研究珊瑚礁自然狀態以及氣候變遷影響的重要場域。群島也是海鳥繁殖地與海龜棲息地。由吉里巴斯政府負責管理，因海域廣大，監督與執法具有高度挑戰。
highlights: 面積約408,250平方公里，是規模極大的海洋保護區
包含十四座已知海底山與深海棲地
已知約兩百種珊瑚與五百種魚類
遠離人煙，珊瑚礁維持相對原始的狀態
是海鳥繁殖地與海龜棲息地

zh: 地母天父海洋國家名勝
en_desc: Papahānaumokuākea is a vast and isolated linear cluster of small, low lying islands and atolls, with their surrounding ocean, roughly 250 km to the northwest of the main Hawaiian Archipelago and extending over some 1931 km. The area has deep cosmological and traditional significance for living Native Hawaiian culture, as an ancestral environment, as an embodiment of the Hawaiian concept of kinship between people and the natural world, and as the place where it is believed that life originates and to where the spirits return after death. On two of the islands, Nihoa and Makumanamana, there are archaeological remains relating to pre-European settlement and use. Much of the monument is made up of pelagic and deepwater habitats, with notable features such as seamounts and submerged banks, extensive coral reefs and lagoons. It is one of the largest marine protected areas (MPAs) in the world.
intro: 地母天父（Papahānaumokuākea）位於夏威夷主群島西北約兩百五十公里處，是一串狹長而孤立的低地小島與環礁，連同周圍海洋綿延約一千九百三十一公里。這處複合遺產依據標準（iii）、（vi）、（viii）、（ix）與（x）登錄。對活著的夏威夷原住民文化而言，這裡具有深厚的宇宙觀與傳統意義，是祖先所在的環境，體現人與自然之間親族關係的概念，也被認為是生命的起源，以及死後靈魂返回之處。在尼豪島與馬庫馬那馬那島（Makumanamana）上，留有前歐洲人時期定居與使用的考古遺跡。保護區大部分是海洋，包含珊瑚礁、潟湖與深海環境，是許多海洋生物與海鳥的棲息地，有為數眾多的特有種，並提供夏威夷僧海豹、綠蠵龜等物種重要的棲地。從地質角度看，這些島嶼也是夏威夷－天皇海山鏈的一部分，呈現火山島隨板塊移動而下沉、轉變為環礁的過程。保護區禁止商業性捕撈，管理單位持續處理海洋垃圾與氣候變遷的影響。
highlights: 由低地小島、環礁與周圍海洋組成，綿延約一千九百公里
對夏威夷原住民而言是生命起源與靈魂歸處
尼豪島與馬庫馬那馬那島有前歐洲人時期遺跡
是夏威夷僧海豹與綠蠵龜等物種的重要棲地
展現火山島下沉並轉為環礁的地質過程

en: Central Sector of the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long - Hanoi
en_desc: The Thang Long Imperial Citadel was built in the 11th century by the Ly Viet Dynasty, marking the independence of the Dai Viet. It was constructed on the remains of a Chinese fortress dating from the 7th century, on drained land reclaimed from the Red River Delta in Hanoi. It was the centre of regional political power for almost 13 centuries without interruption. The Imperial Citadel buildings and the remains in the 18 Hoang Dieu Archaeological Site reflect a unique South-East Asian culture specific to the lower Red River Valley, at the crossroads between influences coming from China in the north and the ancient Kingdom of Champa in the south.
intro: 昇龍皇城位於越南河內，是李朝於十一世紀興建的皇城，象徵大越國的獨立。皇城建於七世紀中國城堡的遺跡之上，座落在紅河三角洲填平的土地上，近十三個世紀以來，一直是地區政治權力的中心。遺產包括皇城的建築與遺跡，以及黃耀街十八號考古遺址。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（vi）登錄，因為它反映出紅河下游流域特有的東南亞文化，處於北方中國與南方古占婆王國影響的交會點。考古發掘出土了各時期的宮殿基址、排水系統、陶瓷與磚瓦等遺物，呈現從唐代到近代皇城的層層疊加。遺址內現存的建築，有後來法國殖民及二十世紀的軍事建物，也為這片地層增添了近代的歷史。皇城的中軸線與建築布局，體現了東亞都城規劃的傳統，同時有越南自身的特色。目前遺址持續進行考古與修復，並向公眾開放。
highlights: 李朝十一世紀興建，象徵大越國獨立
近十三個世紀以來一直是地區政治權力中心
黃耀街十八號考古遺址出土各時期遺物
處於中國與古占婆文化影響的交會點
遺址層層疊加，涵蓋不同時期的歷史

zh: 德拉伊耶遺址的阿圖賴夫區
en_desc: This property was the first capital of the Saudi Dynasty, in the heart of the Arabian Peninsula, north-west of Riyadh. Founded in the 15th century, it bears witness to the Najdi architectural style, which is specific to the centre of the Arabian peninsula. In the 18th and early 19th century, its political and religious role increased, and the citadel at at-Turaif became the centre of the temporal power of the House of Saud and the spread of the S alafiyya reform inside the Muslim religion. The property includes the remains of many palaces and an urban ensemble built on the edge of the ad-Dir’iyah oasis.
intro: 阿圖賴夫區位於德拉伊耶，在沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德西北方，位處阿拉伯半島中心，是沙烏地王朝的第一個首都。它創建於十五世紀，見證了阿拉伯半島中部特有的納季德建築風格。十八世紀至十九世紀初，其政治與宗教地位日益提升，阿圖賴夫的城堡成為沙烏德家族世俗權力的中心，也是薩拉菲耶改革運動在伊斯蘭教內傳播的據點。這處遺產依據標準（iv）、（v）與（vi）登錄，其中包含許多宮殿遺跡，以及座落在德拉伊耶綠洲邊緣的城市建築群。建築使用泥磚夯築，適應沙漠的炎熱氣候，牆體厚實，外觀簡樸而具幾何裝飾。遺址顯示了在乾燥環境中人們如何善用綠洲與河谷資源，建立起政治與宗教權力的核心。1818年該城遭到攻陷，其後權力中心移往利雅德。近年遺址進行了大規模的保存與修復，並規劃為文化旅遊與教育場所。
highlights: 沙烏地王朝的第一個首都，位於阿拉伯半島中心
保存阿拉伯半島中部特有的納季德建築風格
泥磚建築適應沙漠氣候，外觀簡樸而有幾何裝飾
與薩拉菲耶改革運動的傳播密切相關
城區位於德拉伊耶綠洲的邊緣地帶

en: Residence of Bukovinian and Dalmatian Metropolitans
zh: 布科維納與達爾馬提亞都主教官邸
en_desc: The Residence of Bukovinian and Dalmatian Metropolitans represents a masterful synergy of architectural styles built by Czech architect Josef Hlavka from 1864 to 1882. The property, an outstanding example of 19th-century historicist architecture, also includes a seminary and monastery and is dominated by the domed, cruciform Seminary Church with a garden and park. The complex expresses architectural and cultural influences from the Byzantine period onward and embodies the powerful presence of the Orthodox Church during Habsburg rule, reflecting the Austro-Hungarian Empire policy of religious tolerance.
intro: 布科維納與達爾馬提亞都主教官邸位於烏克蘭切爾諾夫策（切爾諾維茨），由捷克建築師約瑟夫·赫拉夫卡於1864至1882年間設計興建，展現了多種建築風格的巧妙結合。它是十九世紀歷史主義建築的傑出範例，除官邸外還包括神學院與修道院，整體由帶圓頂的十字形神學院教堂主導，並配有花園與公園。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（iv）登錄，建築群表現出自拜占庭時期以來的建築與文化影響，也體現了東正教會在哈布斯堡統治時期的強大存在，並反映了奧匈帝國的宗教寬容政策。建築以紅磚為主，並使用彩色屋瓦組成幾何圖案，結合了拜占庭、羅馬式、哥德式與巴洛克等風格元素，內部則有華麗的裝飾與壁畫。如今這處建築群作為切爾諾夫策大學的校區使用，保護工作與教學使用並行。其所在地區在歷史上曾屬於不同政權，因而也是多民族與多宗教共存的象徵。
highlights: 由捷克建築師約瑟夫·赫拉夫卡於1864至1882年設計
是十九世紀歷史主義建築的傑出範例
包含官邸、神學院、修道院與圓頂十字形教堂
融合拜占庭、羅馬式與哥德式等多種風格元素
如今作為切爾諾夫策大學的校區使用
zh_note: 原譯「布科維納與達爾馬提亞的城市民居」為誤譯，原文 Residence of Metropolitans 指東正教都主教官邸，已改正。

en_desc: Konso Cultural Landscape is an arid property of stone walled terraces and fortified settlements in the Konso highlands of Ethiopia. It constitutes a spectacular example of a living cultural tradition stretching back 21 generations (more than 400 years) adapted to its dry hostile environment. The landscape demonstrates the shared values, social cohesion and engineering knowledge of its communities. The site also features anthropomorphic wooden statues - grouped to represent respected members of their communities and particularly heroic events - which are an exceptional living testimony to funerary traditions that are on the verge of disappearing. Stone steles in the towns express a complex system of marking the passing of generations of leaders.
intro: 孔索文化景觀位於衣索比亞南部的孔索高地，是一片乾燥地帶上由石砌梯田與設防聚落構成的景觀。它是一種活態文化傳統的壯觀例證，延續了二十一代、超過四百年，並適應了乾旱而嚴苛的環境。這處遺產依據標準（iii）與（v）登錄，景觀展現了社群共有的價值觀、社會凝聚力與工程知識。梯田以石牆支撐，可以保水保土，使陡坡得以耕作；聚落則由高大的石牆圍繞。遺產中還有成組的人形木雕像，用以代表受尊敬的社群成員以及英勇事蹟，是葬禮傳統的獨特活證，這項傳統已瀕臨消失。城鎮中的石碑則表達出複雜的社會象徵體系。孔索社會有以世代為基礎的組織制度，公共集會場所在聚落中扮演重要角色，社群成員共同參與梯田維護與聚落管理。這些傳統延續至今，是當地社群面對環境挑戰的集體智慧結晶，但也面臨現代化與人口壓力帶來的變遷。
highlights: 石砌梯田使乾旱的陡坡得以耕作
設防聚落由高大石牆環繞，具防衛功能
人形木雕像是獨特的葬禮傳統見證
石碑傳達複雜的社會象徵體系
傳統延續二十一代，超過四百年

en: West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou
en_desc: The West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou, comprising the West Lake and the hills surrounding its three sides, has inspired famous poets, scholars and artists since the 9th century. It comprises numerous temples, pagodas, pavilions, gardens and ornamental trees, as well as causeways and artificial islands. These additions have been made to improve the landscape west of the city of Hangzhou to the south of the Yangtze river. The West Lake has influenced garden design in the rest of China as well as Japan and Korea over the centuries and bears an exceptional testimony to the cultural tradition of improving landscapes to create a series of vistas reflecting an idealised fusion between humans and nature.
intro: 杭州西湖文化景觀位於中國浙江省杭州市西側，由西湖及其三面環繞的山丘構成，自九世紀以來啟發了許多著名詩人、學者與藝術家。景觀中有眾多寺廟、佛塔、亭閣、園林與觀賞樹木，以及堤岸和人工島嶼。這些設施是為了改善杭州城西的景觀而陸續增建，使整體形成一系列景致。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（vi）登錄，因為西湖影響了中國其他地區以及日本、韓國的園林設計，並為「改善景觀以創造反映人與自然理想融合的一系列景致」這項文化傳統提供了卓越見證。「西湖十景」的命名與畫作、詩文流傳，形成了景觀命名與賞景的模式。白堤與蘇堤分別與唐代白居易及宋代蘇軾的疏浚工程相關，雷峰塔等建築則點綴湖畔。歷代的整治使湖泊免於淤積，維持水體與景觀的穩定。今日西湖是熱門景點，管理上需要處理遊客量、水質與周邊城市發展的影響。
highlights: 湖與三面山丘構成景觀，自九世紀起啟發詩人與畫家
蘇堤與白堤與歷代疏浚工程相關
「西湖十景」確立了景觀命名與賞景的傳統
影響中國及日本、韓國的園林設計
寺廟、佛塔、亭閣與園林點綴湖畔

en_desc: China Danxia is the name given in China to landscapes developed on continental red terrigenous sedimentary beds influenced by endogenous forces (including uplift) and exogenous forces (including weathering and erosion). The inscribed site comprises six areas found in the sub-tropical zone of south-west China. They are characterized by spectacular red cliffs and a range of erosional landforms, including dramatic natural pillars, towers, ravines, valleys and waterfalls. These rugged landscapes have helped to conserve sub-tropical broad-leaved evergreen forests, and host many species of flora and fauna, about 400 of which are considered rare or threatened.
intro: 中國丹霞是中國對發育在大陸紅色陸源沉積岩層上的地貌的稱呼，由內生作用（包括抬升）與外生作用（包括風化與侵蝕）共同塑造。登錄的遺產由六處地區組成，位於中國南方的亞熱帶地帶，景觀特色是壯觀的紅色峭壁，以及多樣的侵蝕地形，包括險峻的天然石柱、石塔、峽谷、山谷與瀑布。這處遺產依據標準（vii）與（viii）登錄，既有出色的自然美景，也是丹霞地貌發育過程的重要例證。險峻的地形使亞熱帶常綠闊葉林得以保存，這些森林為許多動植物提供了棲地，其中約四百種被視為稀有或受威脅。六處地區各處於不同的地貌演化階段，彼此對照，有助於理解丹霞地貌的發育過程。「丹霞」一詞源自廣東的丹霞山。這些地區多已成為自然保護區或風景名勝區，保護與觀光開發之間需要妥善平衡。
highlights: 六處地區分布於中國南方的亞熱帶
紅色峭壁、石柱、石塔、峽谷與瀑布構成特色地貌
六處地區處於不同演化階段，便於對照
地形險峻，保存了亞熱帶常綠闊葉林
約四百種動植物被視為稀有或受威脅

en: Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe
en_desc: The Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe, a semi-desert landscape between the Nile and Atbara rivers, was the heartland of the Kingdom of Kush, a major power from the 8th century B.C. to the 4th century A.D. The property consists of the royal city of the Kushite kings at Meroe, near the River Nile, the nearby religious site of Naqa and Musawwarat es Sufra. It was the seat of the rulers who occupied Egypt for close to a century and features, among other vestiges, pyramids, temples and domestic buildings as well as major installations connected to water management. Their vast empire extended from the Mediterranean to the heart of Africa, and the property testifies to the exchange between the art, architectures, religions and languages of both regions.
intro: 麥羅埃島考古遺址位於尼羅河與阿特巴拉河之間的半沙漠地帶，是庫施王國的核心地區，該王國從公元前八世紀到公元四世紀是一股重要勢力。遺產包括靠近尼羅河的庫施國王皇城麥羅埃，以及鄰近的宗教場所納加與穆薩瓦拉特蘇弗拉。庫施統治者曾占領埃及近一個世紀，遺址保有金字塔、神廟與住宅建築，以及與水資源管理有關的重要設施。庫施的疆域從地中海一直延伸到非洲內陸，遺產見證了撒哈拉以南非洲與地中海世界之間的交流。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）、（iv）與（v）登錄。麥羅埃的金字塔比埃及的更小、更陡，成群聳立於沙漠之中，是此地最醒目的景象；遺址同時顯示庫施人發展出自己的文字與冶鐵傳統，並融合埃及、希臘羅馬與非洲本土的元素。許多建築因風沙與歲月侵蝕而受損，保存工作面臨資源與環境的雙重挑戰。
highlights: 庫施王國的核心地區，從公元前八世紀至公元四世紀
包含皇城麥羅埃、納加與穆薩瓦拉特蘇弗拉
遺址保有金字塔、神廟與水資源管理設施
庫施統治者曾占領埃及近一個世紀
融合埃及、希臘羅馬與非洲本土的元素

en_desc: On the banks of the Tarn river in south-west France, the old city of Albi reflects the culmination of a medieval architectural and urban ensemble. Today the Old Bridge (Pont-Vieux), the Saint-Salvi quarter and its church are testimony to its initial development (10th -11th centuries). Following the Albigensian Crusade against the Cathar heretics (13th century) it became a powerful episcopal city. Built in a unique southern French Gothic style from local brick in characteristic red and orange colours, the lofty fortified Cathedral (late 13th century) dominates the city, demonstrating the power regained by the Roman Catholic clergy. Alongside the Cathedral is the vast bishop’s Palais de la Berbie, overlooking the river and surrounded by residential quarters that date back to the Middle Ages. The Episcopal City of Albi forms a coherent and homogeneous ensemble of monuments and quarters that has remained largely unchanged over the centuries.
intro: 阿爾比主教城位於法國西南部塔恩河畔，古城反映了中世紀建築與城市整體發展的巔峰。如今的舊橋、聖薩爾維區及其教堂，見證了城市最初在十至十一世紀的發展。十三世紀針對卡特里派異端的阿爾比十字軍之後，它成為權力強大的主教城。高聳設防的主教座堂建於十三世紀晚期，以當地磚塊建造，呈現特有的紅色與橙色，屬於獨特的南法哥德式風格，彰顯了羅馬天主教會重獲的權力。大教堂旁邊是廣闊的主教宮貝爾比宮，外觀如同堡壘。這處遺產依據標準（iv）與（v）登錄，因為它是中世紀主教城市的傑出整體，並完整保存了傳統的城市面貌。城市的磚造建築與紅色色調一致，與塔恩河景相映，形成鮮明的天際線。主教座堂內部有大幅壁畫與精美的唱詩班席隔屏。如今貝爾比宮設有以畫家圖盧茲－勞特累克作品為主的博物館，讓這座城市也成為藝術參觀地點。
highlights: 聖塞西爾主教座堂以磚造，色調紅橙，外觀如堡壘
舊橋與聖薩爾維區見證城市早期發展
貝爾比宮是外觀如堡壘的主教宮
主教座堂屬獨特的南法哥德式風格，以磚建成
整體城市面貌以磚造建築統一

en_desc: The Jantar Mantar, in Jaipur, is an astronomical observation site built in the early 18th century. It includes a set of some 20 main fixed instruments. They are monumental examples in masonry of known instruments but which in many cases have specific characteristics of their own. Designed for the observation of astronomical positions with the naked eye, they embody several architectural and instrumental innovations. This is the most significant, most comprehensive, and the best preserved of India's historic observatories. It is an expression of the astronomical skills and cosmological concepts of the court of a scholarly prince at the end of the Mughal period.
intro: 齋浦爾的簡塔·曼塔是十八世紀初興建的天文觀測場所，包含約二十座主要的固定儀器。這些儀器是以磚石砌造的大型已知儀器，許多具有各自獨特的特徵，設計用於以肉眼觀測天體位置，並展現出若干建築與儀器上的創新。它是印度歷史天文臺中最重要、最完整，也是保存最好的一座。這處遺產依據標準（iii）與（iv）登錄，表達了蒙兀兒時代末期一位博學的王公宮廷中的天文技術與宇宙觀。天文臺由齋浦爾的創建者賈伊·辛格二世主持興建，其中包括巨大的日晷，稱為薩姆拉特儀，可以高精度測量時間。其他儀器用來測量太陽、月亮與恆星的位置、星座的運行，以及天體高度與運行等。這些建築具有幾何形式的雕塑感，同時是功能性的科學設備。天文臺至今保存完整，開放參觀，也用於教學與文化展示。
highlights: 約二十座磚石砌造的大型固定儀器
設計用於以肉眼觀測天體位置
薩姆拉特儀是巨大的日晷，可測量時間
由齋浦爾創建者賈伊·辛格二世主持興建
印度歷史天文臺中保存最完整的一座

en_desc: In the wake of World War II, in a move closely related to the beginnings of the Cold War, the United States of America decided to resume nuclear testing in the Pacific Ocean, on Bikini Atoll in the Marshall archipelago. After the displacement of the local inhabitants, 67 nuclear tests were carried out from 1946 to 1958, including the explosion of the first H-bomb (1952). Bikini Atoll has conserved direct tangible evidence that is highly significant in conveying the power of the nuclear tests, i.e. the sunken ships sent to the bottom of the lagoon by the tests in 1946 and the gigantic Bravo crater. Equivalent to 7,000 times the force of the Hiroshima bomb, the tests had major consequences on the geology and natural environment of Bikini Atoll and on the health of those who were exposed to radiation. Through its history, the atoll symbolises the dawn of the nuclear age, despite its paradoxical image of peace and of earthly paradise. This is the first site from the Marshall Islands to be inscribed on the World Heritage List.
intro: 比基尼環礁位於馬紹爾群島，是美國在第二次世界大戰後恢復在太平洋核試驗的地點，這項決定與冷戰的開端密切相關。在當地居民被遷離後，自1946年至1958年間共進行了67次核試驗，其中包括1952年首次氫彈的爆炸。這處遺產依據標準（iv）與（vi）登錄，因為環礁保存了能直接傳達核試驗威力的有形證據，包括1946年試驗中沉入潟湖底的艦船，以及巨大的布拉沃彈坑。布拉沃試驗的威力相當於廣島原子彈的七千倍，對當地環境與居民健康造成嚴重後果。這處遺址象徵核時代的開端，以及核武器對人類與環境的影響，並見證了冷戰時期的國際局勢。比基尼居民至今大多未能返回家園，輻射殘留仍是長期的問題。它的登錄亦著重於這段歷史對和平與核裁軍的意義。潛水者可造訪沉船遺跡，但環礁的使用受到嚴格管理。
highlights: 1946至1958年間在此進行67次核試驗
1952年在此試爆第一枚氫彈
沉入潟湖的艦船與布拉沃彈坑是有形證據
布拉沃試驗威力相當於廣島原子彈的七千倍
當地居民被遷離，至今大多未能返家

en_desc: Older than the Himalaya mountains, the mountain chain of the Western Ghats represents geomorphic features of immense importance with unique biophysical and ecological processes. The site’s high montane forest ecosystems influence the Indian monsoon weather pattern. Moderating the tropical climate of the region, the site presents one of the best examples of the monsoon system on the planet. It also has an exceptionally high level of biological diversity and endemism and is recognized as one of the world’s eight ‘hottest hotspots’ of biological diversity. The forests of the site include some of the best representatives of non-equatorial tropical evergreen forests anywhere and are home to at least 325 globally threatened flora, fauna, bird, amphibian, reptile and fish species.
intro: 西高止山脈位於印度西部，是一條比喜馬拉雅山更古老的山脈，具有重要的地貌特徵，以及獨特的生物物理與生態過程。高海拔的山地森林生態系影響了印度季風的氣候型態，並調節該地區的熱帶氣候，是地球上季風系統最佳的範例之一。這處遺產依據標準（ix）與（x）登錄，因為其生物多樣性與特有種比例極高，被認為是世界八大「最熱點」生物多樣性地區之一。這裡的森林包含全球非赤道熱帶常綠林中最具代表性的部分，是許多受威脅動植物的家園，如亞洲象、孟加拉虎與獅尾獼猴等。山脈沿印度西海岸縱貫南北，以多個分散的區塊組成串聯式遺產，涵蓋國家公園、野生動物保護區與保留森林。山區同時也是許多河流的源頭，供應下游數百萬人的水源與農業所需。保護面臨的壓力包括農業擴張、基礎建設、人類與野生動物衝突，以及氣候變遷。
highlights: 比喜馬拉雅山更古老的山脈
山地森林影響並調節印度季風氣候
被視為世界生物多樣性「最熱點」之一
是亞洲象、孟加拉虎與獅尾獼猴等物種的棲地
由多個分散區塊組成串聯式遺產

en: Cultural Sites of Al Ain (Hafit, Hili, Bidaa Bint Saud and Oases Areas)
en_desc: The Cultural Sites of Al Ain (Hafit, Hili, Bidaa Bint Saud and Oases Areas) constitute a serial property that testifies to sedentary human occupation of a desert region since the Neolithic period with vestiges of many prehistoric cultures. Remarkable vestiges in the property include circular stone tombs (ca 2500 B.C.), wells and a wide range of adobe constructions: residential buildings, towers, palaces and administrative buildings. Hili moreover features one of the oldest examples of the sophisticated aflaj irrigation system which dates back to the Iron Age. The property provides important testimony to the transition of cultures in the region from hunting and gathering to sedentarization.
intro: 艾恩文化遺址（包括哈菲特、希利、比達賓特沙烏德與綠洲地區）位於阿拉伯聯合大公國的阿布達比酋長國，是一處串聯式遺產，見證了自新石器時代以來人類在沙漠地區的定居，保存著許多史前文化的遺跡。其中值得注意的有約公元前2500年的圓形石墓、水井，以及多種泥磚建築，包括住宅、塔樓、宮殿與行政建築。希利還有一處最古老的複雜阿富拉季灌溉系統實例，可追溯至鐵器時代。這處遺產依據標準（iii）、（iv）與（v）登錄，為該地區文化由狩獵採集轉向定居生活提供了重要見證。阿富拉季是利用地下水道引水的灌溉系統，使綠洲農業得以在乾旱地區發展，至今仍是當地傳統的一部分。哈菲特山一帶的墓葬因形狀被稱為「蜂巢墓」，是研究早期青銅時代的重要資料。艾恩綠洲的椰棗種植園仍在使用，與城市發展並存，保護工作需要在遺址維護與都市擴張之間取得平衡。
highlights: 見證沙漠地區自新石器時代起的定居歷史
約公元前2500年的圓形石墓是代表性遺跡
希利有鐵器時代的阿富拉季灌溉系統
遺產包含水井、塔樓、宮殿等泥磚建築
綠洲農業與灌溉傳統延續至今

en_desc: The four sites of the property form a strip 170 km long by 3–15 km wide, crossing Belgium from east to west, consisting of the best-preserved 19th- and 20th-century coal-mining sites of the country. It features examples of the utopian architecture from the early periods of the industrial era in Europe within a highly integrated, industrial and urban ensemble, notably the Grand-Hornu colliery and workers’ city designed by Bruno Renard in the first half of the 19th century. Bois-du-Luc includes numerous buildings erected from 1838 to 1909 and one of Europe’s oldest collieries dating back to the late 17th century. While Wallonia had hundreds of collieries, most have lost their infrastructure, while the four components of the listed site retain a high measure of integrity.
intro: 瓦隆主要礦業遺址由四處遺址組成，形成一條長約170公里、寬3至15公里的帶狀地區，由東向西橫貫比利時，是該國保存最完好的十九、二十世紀煤礦遺址。遺產展示了歐洲工業時代初期的烏托邦式建築，是高度整合的工業與城市整體，其中以布魯諾·雷納德在十九世紀上半葉設計的大霍爾尼煤礦與工人城最具代表性。布瓦迪呂克則有建於1838至1909年間的多座建築，以及歐洲最古老的煤礦之一，可追溯到十七世紀晚期。這處遺產依據標準（ii）與（iv）登錄，因為它見證了十九世紀歐洲工業化過程中，技術與人員的交流，以及工人居住與社會規劃的理念。瓦隆地區曾有數百座煤礦，大多數已失去原有設施，這四處遺址因而格外珍貴。其中有些地點今日已轉為博物館與文化場所，如大霍爾尼的當代藝術博物館，讓礦業遺產得以重新利用並向公眾開放。
highlights: 四處遺址構成橫貫比利時的帶狀地區
大霍爾尼的煤礦與工人城是烏托邦式建築的代表
布瓦迪呂克有歐洲最古老的煤礦之一
保存了十九、二十世紀煤礦的完整面貌
部分遺址已轉為博物館與文化場所

en: Sheikh Safi al-din Khānegāh and Shrine Ensemble in Ardabil
zh: 謝赫·薩菲·丁汗那卡和聖地集合體
en_desc: Built between the beginning of the 16 th century and the end of the 18 th century, this place of spiritual retreat in the Sufi tradition uses Iranian traditional architectural forms to maximize use of available space to accommodate a variety of functions (including a library, a mosque, a school, mausolea, a cistern, a hospital, kitchens, a bakery, and some offices). It incorporates a route to reach the shrine of the Sheikh divided into seven segments, which mirror the seven stages of Sufi mysticism, separated by eight gates, which represent the eight attitudes of Sufism. The ensemble includes well-preserved and richly ornamented facades and interiors, with a remarkable collection of antique artefacts. It constitutes a rare ensemble of elements of medieval Islamic architecture.
intro: 謝赫·薩菲·丁汗那卡和聖地集合體位於伊朗西北部的阿爾達比勒，興建於十六世紀初至十八世紀末，是蘇非傳統中的靈修場所。建築運用伊朗傳統的建築形式，充分利用空間來容納多種功能，包括圖書館、清真寺、學校、陵墓、蓄水池、醫院、廚房、麵包坊與辦公室。通往聖陵的路線分為七段，呼應蘇非神祕主義的七個階段，並以八道門隔開，象徵蘇非主義的八種態度。這處遺產依據標準（i）、（ii）與（iv）登錄。建築群的立面與內部保存良好，裝飾華麗，並收藏有大量古代文物，如瓷器與書籍，其中部分來自中國。謝赫·薩菲丁是薩法維教團的創立者，其後裔建立了統治伊朗的薩法維王朝，因此這處聖地在伊朗歷史上具有特殊意義。建築群的空間規劃，是將宗教、教育、慈善與日常需求結合的典型實例，也體現伊朗建築中對光線、色彩與幾何的運用。這是一處至今仍具宗教意義的場所，同時開放參觀。
highlights: 興建於十六世紀初至十八世紀末的蘇非靈修場所
通往聖陵的路線分七段，由八道門隔開，具象徵意義
集合圖書館、清真寺、學校、陵墓、醫院與廚房等功能
立面與內部裝飾華麗，並收藏大量古代文物
與薩法維王朝的起源密切相關

en_desc: Tabriz has been a place of cultural exchange since antiquity and its historic bazaar complex is one of the most important commercial centres on the Silk Road. Tabriz Historic Bazaar Complex consists of a series of interconnected, covered, brick structures, buildings, and enclosed spaces for different functions. Tabriz and its Bazaar were already prosperous and famous in the 13th century, when the town, in the province of Eastern Azerbaijan, became the capital city of the Safavid kingdom. The city lost its status as capital in the 16th century, but remained important as a commercial hub until the end of the 18th century, with the expansion of Ottoman power. It is one of the most complete examples of the traditional commercial and cultural system of Iran.
intro: 大不里士市集區位於伊朗東亞塞拜然省的大不里士，這座城市自古就是文化交流的地點，其歷史悠久的市集是絲路上最重要的商業中心之一。市集區由一系列相互連通、有頂的磚造建築、建築群與封閉空間組成，各有不同的功能。大不里士及其市集在十三世紀時已繁榮並享有盛名，城市曾成為當時王朝的首都。十六世紀雖失去首都地位，但直到十八世紀末，隨著鄂圖曼勢力擴張，它仍是重要的商業樞紐。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iii）與（iv）登錄，被視為最完整的傳統封閉式市集建築群之一。磚造拱頂與穹頂的結構適應當地氣候，能在冬夏保持較舒適的室內環境，並讓人流與貨物在遮蔽的通道中流動。市集內有商店、商隊旅館、清真寺、學校與浴場等，形成完整的商業與社會生活空間。市集至今仍在營運，是當地經濟與社會生活的核心，同時也面臨維護老舊建築與現代商業需求之間的調適。
highlights: 絲路上最重要的商業中心之一
由相互連通的有頂磚造建築與空間組成
磚造拱頂與穹頂能調節室內氣候
內有商店、商隊旅館、清真寺、學校與浴場
至今仍在營運，是當地經濟生活的核心

en_desc: Some 40 villages grouped in eight parks situated in north-western Syria provide remarkable testimony to rural life in late Antiquity and during the Byzantine period. Abandoned in the 8th to 10th centuries, the villages, which date from the 1st to 7th centuries, feature a remarkably well preserved landscape and the architectural remains of dwellings, pagan temples, churches, cisterns, bathhouses etc. The relict cultural landscape of the villages also constitutes an important illustration of the transition from the ancient pagan world of the Roman Empire to Byzantine Christianity. Vestiges illustrating hydraulic techniques, protective walls and Roman agricultural plot plans furthermore offer testimony to the inhabitants' mastery of agricultural production.
intro: 敘利亞北部古村落群位於敘利亞西北部，約有四十座村落分屬八處公園，為古代晚期與拜占庭時期的鄉村生活提供了傑出見證。這些村落年代從公元一世紀到七世紀，在八至十世紀被廢棄，因而保存了相當完好的景觀，以及住宅、異教神殿、教堂、蓄水池與浴場等建築遺跡。這處遺產依據標準（iii）、（iv）與（v）登錄，其遺留的文化景觀是從古羅馬帝國的異教世界過渡到拜占庭基督教的重要例證，也留有水利技術、防護牆與羅馬農地規劃的痕跡，可以呈現當時的農業與聚落模式。由於是石造建築，村落至今仍保有屋頂以外的大部分結構，讓人得以了解古代民居的樣貌。2013年，這處遺產與敘利亞其他五處世界遺產一同被列入瀕危名錄，原因是敘利亞內戰的武裝衝突對遺產造成直接與間接的威脅，也使有效的保護與管理難以進行。在當前局勢下，遺址的實際損害與保存情況難以全面評估。
highlights: 約四十座村落分屬八處公園，年代為一至七世紀
展現古代晚期與拜占庭時期的鄉村生活
見證從羅馬異教世界過渡到拜占庭基督教
保留住宅、神殿、教堂、蓄水池與浴場遺跡
因敘利亞內戰衝突，於2013年列入瀕危名錄

en: Seventeenth-Century Canal Ring Area of Amsterdam inside the Singelgracht
zh: 阿姆斯特丹辛厄爾運河以內的十七世紀運河環帶區
en_desc: The historic urban ensemble of the canal district of Amsterdam was a project for a new ‘port city’ built at the end of the 16th and beginning of the 17th centuries. It comprises a network of canals to the west and south of the historic old town and the medieval port that encircled the old town and was accompanied by the repositioning inland of the city’s fortified boundaries, the Singelgracht. This was a long-term programme that involved extending the city by draining the swampland, using a system of canals in concentric arcs and filling in the intermediate spaces. These spaces allowed the development of a homogeneous urban ensemble including gabled houses and numerous monuments. This urban extension was the largest and most homogeneous of its time. It was a model of large-scale town planning, and served as a reference throughout the world until the 19th century.
intro: 阿姆斯特丹的十七世紀運河環區（辛格爾運河以內）是一項新「港口城市」計畫的歷史性都市整體，建於十六世紀末至十七世紀初。它包括位於歷史舊城與中世紀港口西側及南側的運河網絡，環繞舊城，同時將城市的防禦邊界向內陸推移，即辛格爾運河。這是一項長期的計畫，透過排乾沼澤、以同心弧形的運河系統向外擴展城市，並填平中間的空地。這處遺產依據標準（i）、（ii）與（iv）登錄，因為它代表了一項規模龐大、周密規劃的城市擴張，成為後來世界各地城市規劃的典範。這種空間得以發展出統一的都市整體，其中有山牆房屋和眾多紀念性建築，如王子運河、皇帝運河與紳士運河一帶的商人住宅。運河同時擔負交通、排水與防禦的功能，反映了荷蘭人在水利工程與都市管理上的專長，也和當時荷蘭作為貿易大國的繁榮相呼應。今日運河區仍為居住與商業使用，城市的保護面臨觀光壓力與居住品質之間的平衡。
highlights: 同心弧形運河網絡環繞舊城，向外擴展城市
透過排乾沼澤與填土，形成統一的都市整體
山牆房屋與商人住宅構成主要街景
運河兼具交通、排水與防禦功能
成為後來城市規劃的重要典範

en_desc: Camino Real de Tierra Adentro was the Royal Inland Road, also known as the Silver Route. The inscribed property consists of 55 sites and five existing World Heritage sites lying along a 1400 km section of this 2600 km route, that extends north from Mexico City to Texas and New Mexico, United States of America. The route was actively used as a trade route for 300 years, from the mid-16th to the 19th centuries, mainly for transporting silver extracted from the mines of Zacatecas, Guanajuato and San Luis Potosí, and mercury imported from Europe. Although it is a route that was motivated and consolidated by the mining industry, it also fostered the creation of social, cultural and religious links in particular between Spanish and Amerindian cultures.
intro: 皇家內陸大道又稱「白銀之路」，遺產由55處場所與5處既有世界遺產組成，分布於這條2,600公里道路中約1,400公里的路段上。這條道路從墨西哥城向北延伸至美國德克薩斯州與新墨西哥州。它在十六世紀中葉到十九世紀間的三百年裡一直是活躍的貿易路線，主要運送薩卡特卡斯、瓜納華托與聖路易斯波托西等地礦山開採的白銀，以及從歐洲進口的水銀。這處遺產依據標準（ii）與（iv）登錄。這條路雖然因採礦業而興起並鞏固，卻也促進了沿線社會、文化與宗教的聯繫，帶動了西班牙文化與原住民文化之間的交流。沿途的城鎮、礦場、教堂、驛站、橋梁與莊園構成了遺產的主要內容，呈現殖民時期內陸地區的經濟與社會網絡。這些資產分布在墨西哥境內，並涵蓋多個不同州分，管理上需要跨地區協調。遺產因此不只是單一道路，而是由路線與沿途聚落共同構成的文化路線。
highlights: 又稱「白銀之路」，由墨西哥城向北通往德克薩斯與新墨西哥
遺產含55處場所，分布於約1,400公里路段
三百年間運送白銀與自歐洲進口的水銀
促進西班牙文化與原住民文化的交流
沿途城鎮、礦場、教堂與橋梁共同構成文化路線

en: Prehistoric Caves of Yagul and Mitla in the Central Valley of Oaxaca
zh: 瓦哈卡州中央谷地的亞古爾和米特拉史前洞穴
en_desc: This property lies on the northern slopes of the Tlacolula valley in subtropical central Oaxaca and consists of two pre-Hispanic archaeological complexes and a series of pre-historic caves and rock shelters. Some of these shelters provide archaeological and rock-art evidence for the progress of nomadic hunter-gathers to incipient farmers. Ten thousand-year-old Cucurbitaceae seeds in one cave, Guilá Naquitz, are considered to be the earliest known evidence of domesticated plants in the continent, while corn cob fragments from the same cave are said to be the earliest documented evidence for the domestication of maize. The cultural landscape of the Prehistoric Caves of Yagul and Mitla demonstrates the link between man and nature that gave origin to the domestication of plants in North America, thus allowing the rise of Mesoamerican civilizations.
intro: 這處遺產位於墨西哥瓦哈卡州中部亞熱帶地區的特拉科盧拉谷地北坡，包含兩個前西班牙時期的考古遺址群，以及一系列史前洞穴與岩棚。其中部分岩棚提供了考古學與岩畫證據，說明遊牧狩獵採集者逐步轉向初期農耕的過程。吉拉納奎茨洞穴中出土的一萬年前葫蘆科種子，被認為是美洲大陸最早的作物馴化證據，而同一洞穴出土的玉米穗軸碎片，則被認為是玉米馴化最早的文獻記錄。這處遺產依據標準（iii）登錄，其文化景觀呈現出從遊牧到定居農業的轉變過程，是美洲農業起源的重要見證。亞古爾和米特拉則是後來薩波特克文明與米斯特克文明的遺址，米特拉以石材組成的幾何圖案裝飾聞名，宮殿與廣場呈現出複雜的建築設計。這些遺址顯示谷地從史前到後古典時期的長期人類活動，也是了解中美洲早期農業與社會演進的關鍵資料。
highlights: 吉拉納奎茨洞穴出土最早的作物馴化證據之一
一萬年前的葫蘆科種子與玉米穗軸碎片
呈現遊牧狩獵採集者轉向農耕的過程
米特拉以石材幾何圖案裝飾聞名
涵蓋史前洞穴與前西班牙時期遺址群

en_desc: The site encompasses a rugged and extensively forested mountainous region in the south-east of Jamaica, which provided refuge first for the indigenous Tainos fleeing slavery and then for Maroons (former enslaved peoples). They resisted the European colonial system in this isolated region by establishing a network of trails, hiding places and settlements, which form the Nanny Town Heritage Route. The forests offered the Maroons everything they needed for their survival. They developed strong spiritual connections with the mountains, still manifest through the intangible cultural legacy of, for example, religious rites, traditional medicine and dances. The site is also a biodiversity hotspot for the Caribbean Islands with a high proportion of endemic plant species, especially lichens, mosses and certain flowering plants.
intro: 藍山與約翰烏鴉山位於牙買加東南部，是一片崎嶇且森林覆蓋廣泛的山區，這裡先是為逃離奴役的泰諾原住民提供庇護，之後又成為馬龍人（前奴隸）的避難所。他們在這片偏遠地區抵抗歐洲殖民體制，建立了由小徑、藏身處與聚落組成的網絡，形成「南妮鎮遺產路線」。這處複合遺產依據標準（iii）、（vi）與（x）登錄。森林提供了馬龍人生存所需的一切，他們也與這些山地發展出強烈的精神連結，至今仍顯現在宗教儀式、傳統醫藥與舞蹈等無形文化遺產上。這裡同時是生物多樣性的熱點，擁有大量特有的植物與動物，包括牙買加特有的蝴蝶與蛙類，許多物種僅見於這個島嶼。山區的雲霧林與不同海拔的植被，為這些物種提供多樣的棲地。藍山咖啡即產於此區域一帶，是當地知名的農產。馬龍人的抗爭歷史與自然生態在此緊密交織，保護工作也包括維護這項文化記憶與自然環境。
highlights: 先後為泰諾人與馬龍人提供避難與抵抗殖民的據點
南妮鎮遺產路線由小徑、藏身處與聚落構成
宗教儀式、傳統醫藥與舞蹈延續山地精神連結
是生物多樣性熱點，特有物種眾多
兼具文化與自然價值的複合遺產

en_desc: The 14th -century Ho Dynasty citadel, built according to the feng shui principles, testifies to the flowering of neo-Confucianism in late 14th century Viet Nam and its spread to other parts of east Asia. According to these principles it was sited in a landscape of great scenic beauty on an axis joining the Tuong Son and Don Son mountains in a plain between the Ma and Buoi rivers. The citadel buildings represent an outstanding example of a new style of south-east Asian imperial city.
intro: 西都城是越南十四世紀的胡朝都城，位於清化省，依風水原則建造。它見證了十四世紀晚期新儒學在越南的興盛，並傳播到東亞其他地區。依據風水觀念，城址選在風景優美的地點，位於連接象山與屯山的軸線上，坐落在馬江與菩江之間的平原。這處遺產依據標準（ii）與（iv）登錄，城內的建築是東南亞新式帝王都城的傑出範例。城牆以大塊石材砌成，石塊切割精準並緊密嵌合，南門保存較為完整，是遺址最醒目的部分。胡季犛於1397年左右建造此城，並遷都於此，但這個王朝很短暫，不久即被明朝軍隊擊敗，都城也隨之沒落。城內過去有宮殿、祭壇與宗廟等建築，如今大多僅存基址，考古發掘持續為認識當時的建築與城市規劃提供資料。遺址周邊為農村地區，保護工作須兼顧當地居民的生活與文物的保存。
highlights: 十四世紀胡朝都城，依風水原則建造
城址位於象山與屯山的軸線上，介於馬江與菩江之間
城牆以大塊石材精準砌成，南門保存較完整
反映十四世紀新儒學在越南的興盛
城內宮殿等建築多僅存基址而已

en_desc: Fishing and shellfish gathering have sustained human life in the 5,000 km2 property, which is formed by the arms of three rivers. The site comprises brackish channels encompassing over 200 islands and islets, mangrove forest, an Atlantic marine environment, and dry forest. The site is marked by 218 shellfish mounds, some of them several hundreds metres long, produced by its human inhabitants over the ages. Burial sites on 28 of the mounds take the form of tumuli where remarkable artefacts have been found. They are important for our understanding of cultures from the various periods of the delta's occupation and testify to the history of human settlement along the coast of West Africa.
intro: 薩盧姆河三角洲位於塞內加爾，面積約五千平方公里，由三條河流的支流形成。漁撈與採集貝類長久以來維繫著當地人類的生活。遺產包含半鹹水河道、兩百多座島嶼與小島、紅樹林、大西洋海洋環境與乾燥森林。這處遺產依據標準（iii）、（iv）與（v）登錄，景觀的特色是218座貝塚，由歷代居民堆積而成，其中有些長達數百公尺。在其中28座貝塚上有以墳丘形式出現的墓葬，出土了重要的文物。這些貝塚對理解三角洲各時期的文化相當重要，也見證了西非沿海人類定居的歷史。三角洲內傳統的生活方式延續至今，居民仍從事漁業與貝類採集，並與紅樹林和海洋環境密切互動。貝塚本身由貝殼堆積而成，累積時間可達上千年，成為了解古代飲食、貿易與喪葬習俗的重要資料。保護所面臨的挑戰包括紅樹林退化、過度捕撈與氣候變遷造成的海平面上升。
highlights: 遺產包含半鹹水河道、兩百多座島嶼、紅樹林與乾燥森林
景觀中有218座貝塚，有些長達數百公尺
其中28座貝塚上有墳丘形式的墓葬
見證西非沿海長期的人類定居歷史
居民至今仍從事漁撈與貝類採集

zh: 北部-加來海峽的採礦盆地
en_desc: Remarkable as a landscape shaped over three centuries of coal extraction from the 1700s to the 1900s, the site consists of 109 separate components over 120,000 ha. It features mining pits (the oldest of which dates from 1850) and lift infrastructure, slag heaps (some of which cover 90 ha and exceed 140 m in height), coal transport infrastructure, railway stations, workers’ estates and mining villages including social habitat, schools, religious buildings, health and community facilities, company premises, owners and managers’ houses, town halls and more. The site bears testimony to the quest to create model workers’ cities from the mid 19th century to the 1960s and further illustrates a significant period in the history of industrial Europe. It documents the living conditions of workers and the solidarity to which it gave rise.
intro: 北部－加來海峽採礦盆地位於法國北部，是歷經三個世紀煤炭開採所塑造的景觀，開採時間從十八世紀持續到二十世紀。遺產由109個分散的組成部分構成，面積達十二萬公頃，包括礦坑（最古老的建於1850年）及升降設施、礦渣堆（有些占地90公頃、高度超過140公尺）、煤炭運輸設施、火車站，以及工人住宅區與礦村，內含社會住宅、學校、宗教建築、醫療與社區設施、公司辦公場所、業主與管理者住宅、市政廳等。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iv）與（vi）登錄，見證了自十九世紀中葉到1960年代，人們試圖創造模範工人城市的努力，也顯示了歐洲重要的社會與工業變遷。這裡的礦工聚落是社會規劃與工業資本主義相結合的產物，企業提供住屋與設施以管理勞動力。煤礦關閉後，礦渣堆與礦坑建築成為地景的一部分，部分被重新利用為文化與藝術場所，如朗斯的羅浮宮分館。當地也持續思考如何記憶與詮釋礦工的歷史。
highlights: 109個組成部分，總面積達十二萬公頃
礦渣堆有些占地90公頃、高度超過140公尺
礦村包含住宅、學校、教堂與醫療設施
反映十九世紀中葉至1960年代的模範工人城市理念
部分礦業建築已轉為文化與藝術場所

en: Historic Jeddah, the Gate to Makkah
zh: 歷史悠久的吉達，通往麥加之門
en_desc: Historic Jeddah is situated on the eastern shore of the Red Sea. From the 7th century AD it was established as a major port for Indian Ocean trade routes, channelling goods to Mecca. It was also the gateway for Muslim pilgrims to Mecca who arrived by sea. These twin roles saw the city develop into a thriving multicultural centre, characterized by a distinctive architectural tradition, including tower houses built in the late 19th century by the city’s mercantile elites, and combining Red Sea coastal coral building traditions with influences and crafts from along the trade routes.
intro: 歷史悠久的吉達位於紅海東岸，是沙烏地阿拉伯的歷史港口城市。自公元七世紀起，它即成為印度洋貿易路線的主要港口，將貨物輸送至麥加，同時也是經海路前往麥加朝覲的穆斯林的門戶。這兩項角色讓吉達發展成繁榮的多元文化中心，擁有獨特的建築傳統，其中包括十九世紀晚期由城市商人階層興建的塔樓式住宅，結合了紅海沿岸的珊瑚建築傳統，以及沿著貿易路線傳來的影響與工藝。這處遺產依據標準（ii）、（iv）與（vi）登錄。建築常以珊瑚石砌造，並配有精緻的木製窗格陽臺，稱為「羅珊」，有助於通風並提供隱私。舊城區內有集市、清真寺與住宅，呈現了當地商業與社會生活。吉達舊城稱為「巴拉德」，近年來進行了大規模的修復與保存計畫，但由於建築材料易受潮濕、鹽分與火災影響，保護工作仍具挑戰。
highlights: 七世紀起即為印度洋貿易的重要港口
是前往麥加的海路朝聖者的門戶
塔樓式住宅結合珊瑚石建築傳統
木製窗格陽臺有助通風並保有隱私
舊城稱為「巴拉德」，持續進行修復

en_desc: The property numbers more than 30 islands clustered in three groups and covers surface area of 7,939 hectares. The islands offer a variety of landscapes and are home to a wealth of fauna, including the Bonin Flying Fox, a critically endangered bat, and 195 endangered bird species. Four-hundred and forty-one native plant taxa have been documented on the islands whose waters support numerous species of fish, cetaceans and corals. Ogasawara Islands' ecosystems reflect a range of evolutionary processes illustrated through its assemblage of plant species from both southeast and northwest Asia, alongside many endemic species.
intro: 小笠原群島位於日本本州以南的太平洋，由三十多座島嶼分為三個島群，總面積7,939公頃。群島的地景多樣，棲息著豐富的動物，包括極度瀕危的小笠原大蝙蝠，以及一百九十五種瀕危鳥類。島上已記錄四百四十一種原生植物類群，周圍海域則有多種魚類、鯨豚與珊瑚。這處遺產依據標準（ix）登錄，因為群島的生態系統展現了多種演化過程，植物來自東南亞與西北亞，並有許多特有種。小笠原群島從未與大陸相連，屬於海洋島嶼，物種在隔離環境中獨立演化，陸生蝸牛的適應輻射是著名的例子。因此常被稱為「東洋的加拉巴哥」。外來入侵物種，如野化的貓、老鼠與外來植物，是生態保育的主要威脅，當地積極進行移除與防範工作。島上也有人居住，保護管理需要兼顧居民生活與自然保育。
highlights: 三十多座島嶼分為三個島群，總面積7,939公頃
棲息極度瀕危的小笠原大蝙蝠
植物組成混合東南亞與西北亞的來源
陸生蝸牛的適應輻射是演化的著名例子
外來入侵物種是生態保育的主要威脅

en: Prehistoric Pile Dwellings around the Alps
zh: 阿爾卑斯地區的史前湖岸木樁建築
en_desc: This serial property of 111 small individual sites encompasses the remains of prehistoric pile-dwelling (or stilt house) settlements in and around the Alps built from around 5000 to 500 B.C. on the edges of lakes, rivers or wetlands. Excavations, only conducted in some of the sites, have yielded evidence that provides insight into life in prehistoric times during the Neolithic and Bronze Age in Alpine Europe and the way communities interacted with their environment. Fifty-six of the sites are located in Switzerland. The settlements are a unique group of exceptionally well-preserved and culturally rich archaeological sites, which constitute one of the most important sources for the study of early agrarian societies in the region.
intro: 阿爾卑斯地區的史前湖岸木樁建築是一項串聯式遺產，由111處小型個別遺址組成，保存了約公元前5000年至前500年間，在阿爾卑斯山及周邊的湖岸、河岸或濕地邊緣所建造的史前木樁屋（又稱高腳屋）聚落遺跡。僅部分遺址曾進行發掘，出土的證據讓人得以了解新石器時代與青銅時代阿爾卑斯歐洲的史前生活，以及社群如何與環境互動。其中五十六處遺址位於瑞士。這處遺產依據標準（iv）與（v）登錄，這些聚落構成一批獨特且保存極佳、文化內涵豐富的考古遺址，是研究早期農業社會的重要資料來源之一。由於遺址長期浸沒在水下或泥炭中，缺氧的環境使木材、紡織品、種子與工具等有機物得以保存，這是一般陸地遺址難以達到的。遺產橫跨六個國家，包括奧地利、瑞士、德國、法國、義大利與斯洛維尼亞。遺址大多位於水下，不易參觀，保護重點在於維持水下環境穩定，防止侵蝕與開發破壞。
highlights: 111處小型遺址，年代約公元前5000年至前500年
111處遺址中有五十六處位於瑞士
缺氧環境使木材、紡織品與種子等有機物得以保存
橫跨六個國家的串聯式遺產
遺址大多位於水下，保護重點在維持環境穩定

en: Pearling, Testimony of an Island Economy
zh: 採珠業，島嶼經濟的見證
en_desc: The site consists of seventeen buildings in Muharraq City, three offshore oyster beds, part of the seashore and the Qal’at Bu Mahir fortress on the southern tip of Muharraq Island, from where boats used to set off for the oyster beds. The listed buildings include residences of wealthy merchants, shops, storehouses and a mosque. The site is the last remaining complete example of the cultural tradition of pearling and the wealth it generated at a time when the trade dominated the Gulf economy (2nd century to the 1930s, when Japan developed cultured pearls). It also constitutes an outstanding example of traditional utilization of the sea’s resources and human interaction with the environment, which shaped both the economy and the cultural identity of the island’s society.
intro: 「採珠業，島嶼經濟的見證」位於巴林的穆哈拉克島，遺產包括穆哈拉克市的十七棟建築、三處近海牡蠣礁床、部分海岸，以及位於穆哈拉克島南端的卡拉特布馬希爾堡壘，過去採珠船隊就從這裡出海前往牡蠣礁床。登錄的建築有富商住宅、商店、倉庫與一座清真寺。這處遺產依據標準（iii）登錄，因為它是採珠文化傳統以及由此帶來財富的最後完整例證。採珠貿易曾主導波斯灣的經濟，時間從公元二世紀一直延續到1930年代，其後日本發展出養殖珍珠，才使這項產業衰落。這處遺產同時是傳統利用海洋資源、人與環境互動的傑出範例，反映出以採珠為中心的社會與經濟結構，包括船主、商人與潛水者之間的關係。穆哈拉克舊城的街巷與傳統建築，是理解這段歷史的重要場所。近年當地透過「珍珠之路」步道連結各個遺產地點，並推動修復與活化利用。
highlights: 十七棟建築、三處牡蠣礁床與卡拉特布馬希爾堡壘共同構成遺產
採珠貿易曾主導波斯灣經濟，直到1930年代
富商住宅、商店、倉庫與清真寺反映採珠社會
日本養殖珍珠的發展使採珠業衰落
珍珠之路步道串聯各個遺產地點

en: Selimiye Mosque and its Social Complex
zh: 塞利米耶清真寺及其社會建築群
en_desc: The square Mosque with its single great dome and four slender minarets, dominates the skyline of the former Ottoman capital of Edirne. Sinan, the most famous of Ottoman architects in the 16th century, considered the complex, which includes madrasas (Islamic schools), a covered market, clock house, outer courtyard and library, to be his best work. The interior decoration using Iznik tiles from the peak period of their production testifies to an art form that remains unsurpassed in this material. The complex is considered to be the most harmonious expression ever achieved of the Ottoman külliye, a group of buildings constructed around a mosque and managed as a single institution.
intro: 塞利米耶清真寺位於土耳其西北部的艾迪爾內，這座城市曾是鄂圖曼帝國的首都。清真寺由十六世紀最著名的鄂圖曼建築師希南設計，以方形平面、單一巨大圓頂和四座纖細的宣禮塔主宰城市天際線，希南本人視之為自己最好的作品。登錄標準第一項肯定其建築創意與藝術成就，第四項則肯定它是鄂圖曼「庫利耶」建築群的典範。庫利耶是以清真寺為核心、作為單一機構統一管理的建築組合，此處包括經學院、有頂市集、鐘樓、外庭院與圖書館，各部分配置和諧，被認為是這類建築群最為協調的表現。室內裝飾使用伊茲尼克磁磚，這些磁磚出自該工藝生產的巔峰時期，其品質至今仍難以超越。整體而言，它不僅是宗教建築，也反映了當時結合信仰、教育與商業的社會組織方式。建築師藉由巨大圓頂與寬敞的內部空間，讓禮拜廳顯得開闊而統一，是鄂圖曼古典時期建築成熟的象徵。
highlights: 方形平面配單一大圓頂與四座宣禮塔
建築師希南視其為個人最佳作品
室內使用巔峰時期的伊茲尼克磁磚
含經學院、市集、鐘樓與圖書館的建築群

en: Garrison Border Town of Elvas and its Fortifications
zh: 埃爾瓦斯的駐軍邊境城鎮及其防禦工事
en_desc: The site, extensively fortified from the 17 th to 19 th centuries, represents the largest bulwarked dry-ditch system in the world. Within its walls, the town contains barracks and other military buildings as well as churches and monasteries. While Elvas contains remains dating back to the 10th century ad, its fortification began when Portugal regained independence in 1640. The fortifications designed by Dutch Jesuit padre Cosmander represent the best surviving example of the Dutch school of fortifications anywhere. The site also contains the Amoreira aqueduct, built to enable the stronghold to withstand lengthy sieges.
intro: 埃爾瓦斯位於葡萄牙東部，靠近西班牙邊界，是一座設有駐軍的邊境城鎮。這裡的防禦工事主要在十七至十九世紀間大規模興建，構成世界上規模最大的設有乾壕溝的稜堡式防禦系統。城鎮的歷史可追溯至十世紀的遺跡，但現存防禦體系的興建，始於一六四〇年葡萄牙恢復獨立之後。工事由荷蘭籍耶穌會神父科斯曼德設計，是現存荷蘭學派築城術最好的例子。登錄標準第四項即肯定它作為軍事防禦建築群的傑出範例。城牆之內保留了兵營等軍事建築，以及教堂和修道院，顯示軍事與宗教生活在同一座城鎮中並存。遺產範圍還包括阿莫雷拉水道橋，興建目的是讓要塞能夠承受長時間的圍困。這些設施合起來，呈現出一座邊防城鎮如何在長期戰爭威脅下自給自足。整個防禦體系環繞城鎮，使艾爾瓦斯成為歐洲軍事建築史上的重要案例，也讓人理解邊境城市如何長期守備。
highlights: 世界上規模最大的乾壕溝稜堡式防禦系統
荷蘭學派築城術現存最佳範例
阿莫雷拉水道橋為長期圍城提供水源
城內保留兵營、教堂與修道院

en_desc: Fagus Factory in Alfeld is a 10-building complex - began around 1910 to the design of Walter Gropius, which is a landmark in the development of modern architecture and industrial design. Serving all stages of manufacture, storage and dispatch of lasts used by the shoe industry, the complex, which is still operational today, is situated in Alfeld an der Leine in Lower Saxony. With its groundbreaking vast expanses of glass panels and functionalist aesthetics, the complex foreshadowed the work of the Bauhaus school and is a landmark in the development of architecture in Europe and North America.
intro: 法古斯工廠位於德國下薩克森邦的阿爾費爾德，坐落在萊納河畔，是一組由十棟建築構成的工業建築群。它在一九一〇年前後開始興建，由沃爾特・格羅皮烏斯設計，用於製造鞋楦，涵蓋生產、儲存與發貨的各個階段。登錄標準第二項與第四項，肯定它在現代建築與工業設計發展中的里程碑地位。建築大面積使用玻璃帷幕，強調功能主義美學，預示了後來包浩斯學派的作品，並對歐洲與北美的建築發展產生影響。與多數被列為遺產的歷史建築不同，這裡至今仍在運作，作為工廠繼續使用。因此，它不只是博物館式的展品，而是一處仍有生產活動的現代主義早期建築，讓人看到設計理念如何落實於日常工作空間。它的設計手法後來影響了許多現代建築，今日仍可從建築外觀看出簡潔、明亮而強調功能的設計思想。
highlights: 沃爾特・格羅皮烏斯早期代表作
大面積玻璃帷幕預示包浩斯風格
涵蓋鞋楦製造從生產到發貨的流程
至今仍作為工廠持續運作使用

en_desc: The 604,500 hectare marine and terrestrial property of Ningaloo Coast, on the remote western coast of Australia, includes one of the longest near-shore reefs in the world. On land the site features an extensive karst system and network of underground caves and water courses. Annual gatherings of whale sharks occur at Ningaloo Coast, which is home to numerous marine species, among them a wealth of sea turtles. The terrestrial part of the site features subterranean water bodies with a substantial network of caves, conduits, and groundwater streams. They support a variety of rare species that contribute to the exceptional biodiversity of the marine and terrestrial site
intro: 甯格羅海岸位於澳洲西部偏遠的海岸，範圍包括海域與陸地，面積約六十萬公頃。這裡擁有世界上最長的近岸珊瑚礁之一，陸地部分則有廣大的喀斯特地形，以及由洞穴和地下水道構成的網絡。登錄標準第七項與第十項分別肯定其自然美景，以及作為生物多樣性棲地的重要性。每年在此聚集的鯨鯊是最具代表性的景象，海域也棲息著眾多海洋生物，其中包括種類繁多的海龜。陸地上的地下水體、洞穴與地下溪流，支持了多種稀有物種，這些物種與海洋生態一起，構成海陸並存的特殊生物多樣性。此處地處偏遠，使整體環境保持相對完整，成為研究熱帶與乾旱地區海岸生態的重要場所。由於地處偏遠且人為開發有限，陸地與海洋環境彼此相連，保護了完整的生態過程，也是鯨鯊等海洋動物重要的活動範圍。
highlights: 世界上最長的近岸珊瑚礁之一
每年有鯨鯊在此聚集覓食與活動
陸地有廣大喀斯特洞穴與地下水系
海域是多種海龜的重要棲地

en: Caves of Maresha and Bet-Guvrin in the Judean Lowlands as a Microcosm of the Land of the Caves
zh: 猶地亞低地的馬雷沙與貝特古夫林洞穴
en_desc: The archaeological site contains some 3,500 underground chambers distributed among distinct complexes carved in the thick and homogenous soft chalk of Lower Judea under the former towns of Maresha and Bet Guvrin. Situated on the crossroads of trade routes to Mesopotamia and Egypt, the site bears witness to the region’s tapestry of cultures and their evolution over more than 2,000 years from the 8 th century BCE—when Maresha, the older of the two towns was built—to the time of the Crusaders. These quarried caves served as cisterns, oil presses, baths, columbaria (dovecotes), stables, places of religious worship, hideaways and, on the outskirts of the towns, burial areas. Some of the larger chambers feature vaulted arches and supporting pillars.
intro: 貝特古夫林國家公園位於以色列猶地亞低地，遺產全名著重於馬雷沙與貝特古夫林兩座古城下方的洞穴系統。這裡約有三千五百個地下洞室，分布於數個洞穴群中，開鑿在厚實而均質的軟質白堊岩中。兩座城鎮位於通往美索不達米亞與埃及的貿易路線交會處，遺址見證了此地多元文化在兩千多年間的演變，時間從公元前八世紀馬雷沙建城，一直延續到十字軍時期。登錄標準第五項肯定其作為人類利用地下空間的傑出例證。這些人工洞穴曾被用作蓄水池、榨油坊、浴場、鴿舍、馬廄、宗教崇拜場所與藏身處，城鎮外圍則有墓葬區。部分較大的洞室還設有拱頂和支撐柱，顯示開鑿技術的成熟。洞穴的形狀與用途多樣，說明居民如何利用容易開鑿的岩層，在地表之下發展出生產、儲水與生活的空間。
highlights: 約三千五百個開鑿於白堊岩中的地下洞室
洞穴曾作為蓄水池、榨油坊、浴場與鴿舍
歷史跨越公元前八世紀至十字軍時期
位於通往美索不達米亞與埃及的貿易要道

en: Cultural Landscape of the Serra de Tramuntana
zh: 特拉蒙塔納山脈文化景觀
en_desc: The Cultural Landscape of the Serra de Tramuntana located on a sheer-sided mountain range parallel to the north-western coast of the island of Mallorca. Millennia of agriculture in an environment with scarce resources has transformed the terrain and displays an articulated network of devices for the management of water revolving around farming units of feudal origins. The landscape is marked by agricultural terraces and inter-connected water works - including water mills - as well as dry stone constructions and farms.
intro: 特拉蒙塔納山脈文化景觀位於西班牙馬略卡島西北部，是一道與海岸平行、山勢陡峭的山脈。數千年來，居民在資源有限的環境中從事農業，逐步改變了地形，形成以封建時期起源的農業單位為核心、管理水資源的一整套設施網絡。登錄標準第二、第四與第五項，分別肯定其文化交流、水利景觀的典範性，以及人類與環境互動所形成的土地利用方式。景觀的特色包括農業梯田，以及彼此連通的水利工程，例如水磨坊，另有乾砌石構造物與農莊。這些元素共同顯示人們如何在乾燥而陡峭的山地取得、儲存和分配水，讓耕作得以長期維持。至今，山區仍可看見這些人工痕跡與自然地貌交織的面貌。這片山地景觀展現了人們長期與稀缺資源協調的成果，至今仍可看到山坡上層層相疊的梯田與石砌結構。
highlights: 山脈與海岸平行，山勢陡峭
農業梯田與乾砌石構造遍布山坡
水磨坊與水利網絡串連農莊
農業單位的起源可追溯到封建時期

en_desc: The property includes nine gardens in as many provinces. They exemplify the diversity of Persian garden designs that evolved and adapted to different climate conditions while retaining principles that have their roots in the times of Cyrus the Great, 6th century BC. Always divided into four sectors, with water playing an important role for both irrigation and ornamentation, the Persian garden was conceived to symbolize Eden and the four Zoroastrian elements of sky, earth, water and plants. These gardens, dating back to different periods since the 6th century BC, also feature buildings, pavilions and walls, as well as sophisticated irrigation systems. They have influenced the art of garden design as far as India and Spain.
intro: 波斯庭園並非單一園林，而是分布在伊朗九個省份的九座庭園，展示了波斯造園藝術如何因應不同氣候條件而發展出多樣面貌。它們保留了可追溯到公元前六世紀居魯士大帝時代的基本原則，登錄標準涵蓋第一、第二、第三、第四與第六項。庭園總是劃分為四個區塊，水既用於灌溉，也具有裝飾作用，整體被構想為象徵伊甸園，以及瑣羅亞斯德教所說的天、地、水與植物四種元素。各園的年代從公元前六世紀以來不一，園內還有建築、涼亭與園牆，並配有精巧的灌溉系統。波斯庭園的設計理念影響深遠，向東傳到印度，向西傳到西班牙，成為世界園林史上的重要一環。這些庭園分別建於不同時代，既保留共同的設計邏輯，也各自反映所在地區的氣候、地形與時代風格。位於不同省份的這些庭園，使人能比較波斯造園藝術在不同時代、不同環境下的延續與變化。
highlights: 九座庭園分布於伊朗九個省份
庭園一律劃分為四個區塊，象徵伊甸園
水既供灌溉也具有裝飾作用
設計理念影響遠至印度與西班牙

en_desc: Established in rural West Bengal in 1901 by the renowned poet and philosopher Rabindranath Tagore, Santiniketan was a residential school and centre for art based on ancient Indian traditions and a vision of the unity of humanity transcending religious and cultural boundaries. A ‘world university’ was established at Santiniketan in 1921, recognizing the unity of humanity or “Visva Bharati”. Distinct from the prevailing British colonial architectural orientations of the early 20th century and of European modernism, Santiniketan represents approaches toward a pan-Asian modernity, drawing on ancient, medieval and folk traditions from across the region.
intro: 桑蒂尼蓋登位於印度西孟加拉邦的鄉村地區，是詩人與哲學家泰戈爾於一九〇一年創立的寄宿學校與藝術中心。它以古代印度傳統為基礎，並懷抱超越宗教與文化界線的人類一體理想。一九二一年，這裡設立了「世界大學」，名稱「維斯瓦・巴拉蒂」即表達人類一體的概念。登錄標準第四項與第六項，肯定其建築與規劃上的創新，以及與重要思想和人物的關聯。其建築有別於二十世紀初英國殖民時期盛行的風格，也不同於歐洲現代主義，而是汲取亞洲各地古代、中世紀與民間傳統，展現一種泛亞洲的現代性。因此，桑蒂尼蓋登既是教育機構，也是一處以空間實踐文化理想的場所。校園與周邊建築多採本地材料與簡樸造型，強調人與自然的關係，這也是泰戈爾教育理念的具體呈現。
highlights: 由泰戈爾於一九〇一年創立
一九二一年設立「世界大學」
建築融合亞洲各地古代與民間傳統
不同於殖民風格與歐洲現代主義的泛亞洲現代性

zh: 布里奇敦及其軍事要塞
en_desc: Historic Bridgetown and its Garrison, an outstanding example of British colonial architecture consisting of a well-preserved old town built in the 17th, 18th and 19th centuries, which testifies to the spread of Great Britain's Atlantic colonial empire. The property also includes a nearby military garrison which consists of numerous historic buildings. With its serpentine urban lay-out the property testifies to a different approach to colonial town-planning compared to the Spanish and Dutch colonial cities of the region which were built along a grid plan.
intro: 布里奇敦及其軍事要塞位於加勒比海的巴貝多，是一座保存良好的英國殖民時期舊城，建於十七、十八與十九世紀，見證了大不列顛大西洋殖民帝國的擴張。遺產範圍也包括鄰近的軍事要塞，內有許多歷史建築。登錄標準第二、第三與第四項，肯定它在殖民建築、城市規劃與文化交流方面的價值。這座城市的街道布局呈蜿蜒曲折的形態，與區域內西班牙和荷蘭殖民城市多採方格網的做法不同，顯示出另一種殖民城鎮規劃思路。舊城的建築反映了英國殖民者的生活與商貿，而要塞則說明了這座港口城市在帝國防務中的位置。兩者合在一起，呈現出一座殖民港市在行政、商業與軍事上的整體面貌。舊城至今仍保存許多歷史街區與公共建築，使人能具體了解英國殖民時期加勒比港口城市的生活與防衛體系。
highlights: 保存良好的十七至十九世紀英國殖民舊城
蜿蜒的街道布局不同於方格網殖民城市
鄰近的軍事要塞保留大量歷史建築
見證英國大西洋殖民帝國的擴張

en_desc: The 74,000-hectare property, inscribed as a mixed natural and cultural site, is situated in southern Jordan, near the border with Saudi Arabia. It features a varied desert landscape consisting of a range of narrow gorges, natural arches, towering cliffs, ramps, massive landslides and caverns. Petroglyphs, inscriptions and archaeological remains in the site testify to 12,000 years of human occupation and interaction with the natural environment. The combination of 25,000 rock carvings with 20,000 inscriptions trace the evolution of human thought and the early development of the alphabet. The site illustrates the evolution of pastoral, agricultural and urban activity in the region.
intro: 瓦地倫保護區位於約旦南部，靠近沙烏地阿拉伯邊界，面積約七萬四千公頃，被列為自然與文化的複合遺產。這裡是多樣化的沙漠景觀，有狹窄的峽谷、天然拱門、高聳的崖壁、斜坡、大規模的山崩堆積與洞穴。登錄標準第三、第五與第七項，分別肯定其文化見證、人與環境互動，以及自然美景。園區內的岩畫、銘文與考古遺跡，見證了長達一萬兩千年的人類居住與利用自然的歷史。約兩萬五千幅岩刻與兩萬件銘文，記錄了人類思想的演變和早期字母的發展。遺產同時顯示了當地畜牧、農業與城市活動的演進，使這片看似荒涼的沙漠，成為理解人類如何適應乾旱環境的重要地點。這片沙漠同時保存地質奇觀與人類活動痕跡，說明自然環境與文化發展如何在同一地點長期交織。
highlights: 自然與文化兼具的複合遺產
峽谷、天然拱門與高聳崖壁的沙漠景觀
約兩萬五千幅岩刻與兩萬件銘文
見證一萬兩千年的人類活動

en_desc: A masterpiece of Baroque theatre architecture, built between 1745 and 1750, the Opera House is the only entirely preserved example of its type where an audience of 500 can experience Baroque court opera culture and acoustics authentically, as its auditorium retains its original materials, i.e. wood and canvas. Commissioned by Margravine Wilhelmine, wife of Frederick, Margrave of Brandenburg–Bayreuth, it was designed by the renowned theatre architect Giuseppe Galli Bibiena. As a court opera house in a public space, it foreshadowed the large public theatres of the 19th century. The highly decorated theatre’s tiered loge structure of wood with illusionistic painted canvas represents the ephemeral ceremonial architectural tradition that was employed in pageants and celebrations for princely self-representation.
intro: 拜羅伊特侯爵歌劇院位於德國巴伐利亞的拜羅伊特，興建於一七四五至一七五〇年，是巴洛克劇院建築的傑作。它由著名劇場建築師朱塞佩・加利・比比恩納設計，由布蘭登堡－拜羅伊特侯爵腓特烈的妻子威廉明妮侯爵夫人委託興建。登錄標準第一項與第四項，肯定其藝術成就以及作為劇院類型的傑出範例。這是同類型中唯一完整保存的實例，觀眾席保留了木材與畫布等原始材料，約五百名觀眾可以在此真實體驗巴洛克宮廷歌劇的文化與音響效果。其木構的分層包廂和帶有錯視效果的彩繪畫布，代表了用於慶典和遊行、為彰顯君主形象而使用的短暫性禮儀建築傳統。作為設於公共空間中的宮廷歌劇院，它也預示了十九世紀大型公共劇院的出現。這座劇院的保存，讓今日的觀眾能更接近十八世紀宮廷歌劇的視覺與聽覺經驗，是研究劇院建築的重要實物。
highlights: 唯一完整保存的巴洛克宮廷歌劇院
觀眾席保留原始的木材與畫布
由名劇院建築師比比恩納設計
可容納約五百名觀眾欣賞演出

en_desc: Situated in the north-western Congo Basin, where Cameroon, Central African Republic and Congo meet, the site encompasses three contiguous national parks totalling around 750,000 ha. Much of the site is unaffected by human activity and features a wide range of humid tropical forest ecosystems with rich flora and fauna, including Nile crocodiles and goliath tigerfish, a large predator. Forest clearings support herbaceous species and Sangha is home to considerable populations of forest elephants, critically endangered western lowland gorilla, and endangered chimpanzee. The site’s environment has preserved the continuation of ecological and evolutionary processes on a huge scale and great biodiversity, including many endangered animal species.
intro: 桑加三國保護區位於剛果盆地西北部，在喀麥隆、中非共和國與剛果（布拉薩）三國交界處，由三座相連的國家公園組成，總面積約七十五萬公頃。登錄標準第九項與第十項，肯定其持續進行的生態與演化過程，以及重要的生物多樣性。園區大部分地區未受人類活動影響，擁有各種潮濕的熱帶森林生態系，動植物豐富，水域中有尼羅鱷與體型大的掠食魚類巨型虎魚。林中空地支持多種草本植物，森林象的數量可觀，也是極危的西部低地大猩猩和瀕危黑猩猩的棲地。這片廣大而相對完整的環境，使生態與演化過程得以延續，並保護了許多瀕危動物。三個國家共同管理，也使它成為跨國保育的重要案例。三國的保護區連成一片，有助於維持大型動物的活動範圍，也讓整個地區的森林生態系得到較完整的保護。
highlights: 由三座相連的國家公園組成
位於喀麥隆、中非與剛果三國交界
大部分地區未受人類活動影響
有森林象與極危的西部低地大猩猩

en: Petroglyphic Complexes of the Mongolian Altai
en_desc: The numerous rock carvings and funerary monuments found in these three sites illustrate the development of culture in Mongolia over a period of 12,000 years. The earliest images reflect a time (11,000 - 6,000 BC) when the area was partly forested and the valley provided a habitat for hunters of large game. Later images show the transition to herding as the dominant way of life. The most recent images show the transition to a horse-dependent nomadic lifestyle during the early 1st millennium BC, the Scythian period and the later Turkic period (7th and 8th centuries AD). The carvings contribute valuably to our understanding of pre-historic communities in northern Asia.
intro: 蒙古阿爾泰山脈岩畫群位於蒙古西部，由三處遺址組成，包含大量岩刻與喪葬紀念物，展示了蒙古地區一萬兩千年來的文化發展。登錄標準第三項，肯定其作為已消逝文化傳統的獨特見證。最早的圖像出現在公元前一萬一千年至前六千年間，當時這一帶部分地區有森林，河谷是獵捕大型獵物者的棲地。較晚的圖像則顯示人們轉向以畜牧為主的生活方式。最近期的圖像反映出公元前一千年初期依賴馬匹的游牧生活，屬斯基泰時期，以及之後的突厥時期，也就是七、八世紀。這些岩刻有助於理解北亞史前社群如何從狩獵過渡到畜牧與游牧，是研究該地區人類活動的珍貴資料。岩畫與墓葬分布於高山與河谷環境，為了解北亞史前人群如何利用這片地區，提供了不可取代的直接證據。
highlights: 三處遺址涵蓋一萬兩千年的文化發展
最早圖像反映獵捕大型獵物的時代
可見從狩獵轉向畜牧與游牧的過程
包含斯基泰與突厥時期的圖像

en_desc: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon covers 100,200 ha and includes 445 uninhabited limestone islands of volcanic origin. Many of them display unique mushroom-like shapes in turquoise lagoons surrounded by coral reefs. The aesthetic beauty of the site is heightened by a complex reef system featuring over 385 coral species and different types of habitat. They sustain a large diversity of plants, birds and marine life including dugong and at least thirteen shark species. The site harbours the highest concentration of marine lakes anywhere, isolated bodies of seawater separated from the ocean by land barriers. They are among the islands’ distinctive features and sustain high endemism of populations which continue to yield new species discoveries. The remains of stonework villages, as well as burial sites and rock art, bear testimony to the organization of small island communities over some three millennia. The abandonment of the villages in the 17th and 18th centuries illustrates the consequences of climate change, population growth and subsistence behaviour on a society living in a marginal marine environment.
intro: 岩礁群島南潟湖位於帛琉，面積約十萬兩百公頃，包含四百四十五座無人居住的石灰岩島嶼，這些島嶼源於火山。許多島嶼呈獨特的蘑菇狀，散布在碧綠的潟湖中，周圍環繞著珊瑚礁。遺產被列為複合遺產，登錄標準涵蓋第三、第五、第七、第九與第十項。複雜的珊瑚礁系統有三百八十五種以上的珊瑚，並提供不同類型的棲地，支持多樣的植物、鳥類與海洋生物，包括儒艮與至少十三種鯊魚。此處也擁有全球最集中的海洋湖，即被陸地屏障與大洋隔開的海水水體，其中的族群具有高度特有性，至今仍不斷發現新物種。島上的石造村落遺跡、墓葬與岩畫，則見證了小型島嶼社群長達數千年的組織方式。自然景觀與人類遺跡並存，使它不僅是海洋保育的重要地點，也是了解太平洋島民長期居住歷史的場域。
highlights: 四百四十五座無人居住的石灰岩島
蘑菇狀島嶼散布在碧綠潟湖中
擁有全球最集中的海洋湖，物種特有性高
保存石造村落、墓葬與岩畫遺跡

en: University of Coimbra – Alta and Sofia
zh: 科英布拉大學：阿爾塔與索菲亞
en_desc: Situated on a hill overlooking the city, the University of Coimbra with its colleges grew and evolved over more than seven centuries within the old town. Notable university buildings include the 12 th century Cathedral of Santa Cruz and a number of 16 th century colleges, the Royal Palace of Alcáçova, which has housed the University since 1537, the Joanine Library with its rich baroque decor, the 18 th century Botanical Garden and University Press, as well as the large “University City” created during the 1940s. The University’s edifices became a reference in the development of other institutions of higher education in the Portuguese-speaking world where it also exerted a major influence on learning and literature. Coimbra offers an outstanding example of an integrated university city with a specific urban typology as well as its own ceremonial and cultural traditions that have been kept alive through the ages.
intro: 科英布拉大學位於葡萄牙，建在俯瞰城市的山丘上，其學院在舊城內歷經七個多世紀成長演變。重要建築包括十二世紀的聖十字主教座堂、多座十六世紀的學院，以及自一五三七年起成為大學校舍的阿爾卡索瓦王宮。此外還有裝飾華麗的巴洛克風格若昂圖書館、十八世紀的植物園與大學出版社，以及一九四〇年代興建的大型「大學城」。登錄標準第二、第四與第六項，肯定其對葡語世界高等教育機構的影響，並肯定它與學術和文學傳承的關聯。這些建築成為葡語世界其他高等教育機構發展時的參照，對學問和文學產生重要影響。科英布拉是整合大學與城市的傑出範例，具有特定的城市形態，並保存了自己的儀式與文化傳統。大學至今仍在運作，學術生活、校園空間與傳統儀式相互結合，使這處遺產維持著鮮明的活的文化特色。
highlights: 學院在山丘上歷經七個多世紀成長
十八世紀若昂圖書館有華麗巴洛克裝飾
一五三七年起以阿爾卡索瓦王宮為校舍
影響葡語世界的高等教育機構

en_desc: A hilly 512 ha site in Yunnan province, Chengjiang’s fossils present the most complete record of an early Cambrian marine community with exceptionally preserved biota, displaying the anatomy of hard and soft tissues in a very wide variety of organisms, invertebrate and vertebrate. They record the early establishment of a complex marine ecosystem. The site documents at least sixteen phyla and a variety of enigmatic groups as well as about 196 species, presenting exceptional testimony to the rapid diversification of life on Earth 530 million years ago, when almost all of today’s major animal groups emerged. It opens a palaeobiological window of great significance to scholarship.
intro: 澄江化石地位於中國雲南省，是一處面積約五百一十二公頃的丘陵地帶。這裡的化石呈現了寒武紀早期海洋生物群落最完整的紀錄，並且保存極其特殊，不但保留硬組織，也保存了軟組織的構造，涵蓋種類繁多的無脊椎動物與脊椎動物。登錄標準第八項，肯定其在地球生命史上的重要價值。遺址記錄了複雜海洋生態系的早期建立，至少涵蓋十六個門類，以及一些難以歸類的特殊類群，並有約一百九十六個物種。這些化石為約五億三千萬年前生命快速多樣化提供了傑出的證據，當時現今幾乎所有主要動物類群相繼出現。對古生物學研究而言，澄江化石地如同一扇窗，讓人得以觀察動物演化大爆發時期的真實生態。這些化石幫助科學家理解現代動物類群的早期面貌，是古生物學界研究早期動物演化時最重要的材料之一。
highlights: 寒武紀早期海洋生物群落最完整的紀錄之一
軟組織與硬組織皆有良好保存
涵蓋至少十六個門類與約一百九十六個物種
記錄約五億三千萬年前生命快速多樣化

en_desc: North of the Great Wall, the Site of Xanadu encompasses the remains of Kublai Khan’s legendary capital city, designed by the Mongol ruler’s Chinese advisor Liu Bingzhdong in 1256. Over a surface area of 25,000 ha, the site was a unique attempt to assimilate the nomadic Mongolian and Han Chinese cultures. From this base, Kublai Khan established the Yuan dynasty that ruled China over a century, extending its boundaries across Asia. The religious debate that took place here resulted in the dissemination of Tibetan Buddhism over north-east Asia, a cultural and religious tradition still practised in many areas today. The site was planned according to traditional Chinese feng shui in relation to the nearby mountains and river. It features the remains of the city, including temples, palaces, tombs, nomadic encampments and the Tiefan’gang Canal, along with other waterworks.
intro: 元上都遺址位於長城以北，是忽必烈傳說中的都城遺跡。這座城市由蒙古統治者的漢人謀士劉秉忠於一二五六年規劃，占地約二萬五千公頃，是一次融合遊牧蒙古文化與漢文化的獨特嘗試。忽必烈以此為基地建立元朝，其疆域擴展到亞洲各地，統治中國逾百年。登錄標準涵蓋第二、第三、第四與第六項。在此舉行的宗教辯論，促使藏傳佛教在東北亞傳播，至今仍有許多地區延續這個傳統。城市依照傳統中國風水，與附近的山脈和河流相配合而規劃。遺址包括城址本身、寺廟、宮殿、陵墓與遊牧營地，以及鐵幡竿渠和其他水利設施，展現了草原與農耕文明交會的面貌。今日遺址位於內蒙古高原的草原地帶，城址、水利設施與周邊的墓葬，說明了這座都城與自然環境的緊密關係。
highlights: 忽必烈建立元朝前的傳說中的都城遺跡
由劉秉忠於一二五六年規劃
依傳統風水配置山河與城市
促成藏傳佛教在東北亞傳播

en: Vineyard Landscape of Piedmont: Langhe-Roero and Monferrato
zh: 朗格—洛埃洛和蒙菲拉托的皮埃蒙特葡萄園景觀
en_desc: This landscape covers five distinct wine-growing areas with outstanding landscapes and the Castle of Cavour, an emblematic name both in the development of vineyards and in Italian history. It is located in the southern part of Piedmont, between the Po River and the Ligurian Apennines, and encompasses the whole range of technical and economic processes relating to the winegrowing and winemaking that has characterized the region for centuries. Vine pollen has been found in the area dating from the 5th century BC, when Piedmont was a place of contact and trade between the Etruscans and the Celts; Etruscan and Celtic words, particularly wine-related ones, are still found in the local dialect. During the Roman Empire, Pliny the Elder mentions the Piedmont region as being one of the most favourable for growing vines in ancient Italy; Strabo mentions its barrels.
intro: 皮埃蒙特葡萄園景觀位於義大利北部皮埃蒙特南部，介於波河與利古里亞亞平寧山脈之間，涵蓋五個各具特色的葡萄酒產區，以及卡富爾城堡。卡富爾之名無論在葡萄園發展還是義大利歷史上都具象徵意義。登錄標準第三項與第五項，肯定其作為葡萄種植與釀酒傳統的見證，以及人與土地互動而形成的文化景觀。遺產涵蓋了數世紀以來塑造當地特色的葡萄栽培與釀造的完整技術與經濟過程。考古發現顯示，公元前五世紀此地已有葡萄花粉，當時皮埃蒙特是伊特魯里亞人與凱爾特人接觸和貿易的地方，當地方言中至今仍保留與葡萄酒相關的伊特魯里亞和凱爾特詞彙。羅馬帝國時期，老普林尼提到這裡是古義大利最適合種植葡萄的地區之一。這片葡萄園景觀不僅依靠自然條件，也依靠世代相傳的技術與地方社群，使葡萄酒文化成為地方認同的一部分。
highlights: 涵蓋五個各具特色的葡萄酒產區
包含與義大利史關係密切的卡富爾城堡
葡萄花粉證據可追溯至公元前五世紀
地方方言仍保留伊特魯里亞與凱爾特酒類詞彙

en: Sites of Human Evolution at Mount Carmel: The Nahal Me’arot / Wadi el-Mughara Caves
zh: 迦密山人類演化遺址：納哈爾梅阿羅特／瓦迪穆加拉洞穴
en_desc: Situated on the western slopes of the Mount Carmel range, the site includes the caves of Tabun, Jamal, el-Wad and Skhul. Ninety years of archaeological research have revealed a cultural sequence of unparalleled duration, providing an archive of early human life in south-west Asia. This 54 ha property contains cultural deposits representing at least 500,000 years of human evolution demonstrating the unique existence of both Neanderthals andEarly Anatomically Modern Humans within the same Middle Palaeolithic cultural framework, the Mousterian. Evidence from numerous Natufian burials and early stone architecture represents the transition from a hunter-gathering lifestyle to agriculture and animal husbandry. As a result, the caves have become a key site of the chrono-stratigraphic framework for human evolution in general, and the prehistory of the Levant in particular.
intro: 邁梅爾山人類演化遺址位於以色列卡梅爾山西側山坡，包括塔邦、賈邁勒、埃爾瓦德與斯庫爾等洞穴。經過九十年的考古研究，這裡揭示了一段時間長度無可比擬的文化序列，成為西南亞早期人類生活的檔案庫。遺址面積約五十四公頃，文化堆積至少代表五十萬年的人類演化，顯示在同一個中期舊石器時代文化框架，即莫斯特文化中，尼安德塔人和早期解剖學上的現代人曾並存。登錄標準第三項與第五項。納圖夫文化的許多墓葬和早期石造建築，則代表了從狩獵採集生活轉向農耕與畜牧的過程。因此，這些洞穴成為人類演化整體年代序列，以及黎凡特史前史的關鍵遺址。這些洞穴的堆積層厚而連續，為研究人類行為、技術與生活方式的長期變化，提供了難得的考古資料。遺址的研究成果，長期為探討現代人類起源與尼安德塔人的關係提供重要的比較資料。
highlights: 文化堆積至少代表五十萬年的人類演化
尼安德塔人與早期現代人共享莫斯特文化
納圖夫墓葬與早期石造建築
塔邦、賈邁勒、埃爾瓦德與斯庫爾四處洞穴
zh_prev: 梅爾瓦特河原始保留區
